product.description:
The Floorwarmers Electric Underfloor Heating Mat Kit 100W offers a versatile solution for various floor coverings, ensuring exceptional reliability and hassle-free installation. Here's what you need to know about this kit:

Key Features:

Versatile Solution: Designed to cater to all types of floor coverings, offering exceptional reliability and hassle-free installation.
Long-lasting Warranty: Each product comes with a generous 25-year warranty, providing peace of mind and ensuring satisfaction.
Thermostat Options: A wide range of thermostats is available to enhance your heating experience, including advanced WiFi thermostats for smart home automation and stylish touchscreen thermostats.
Affordable Quality: Combines affordability with quality, offering excellent value for money and luxury of heated floors at an affordable price point.
Multiple Output Options: Available in 150W and 200W outputs, suitable for both primary heating and supplemental heating purposes.
Kit Includes:

Underfloor Heating Sticky Mat (Two individual mats if kit size is over 12m²)
Floor Primer: High-performance universal priming/sealing agent suitable for various substrates
Roller: High-quality roller for applying floor primer to the subfloor
Adhesive Tape: Assists in holding the mat or cable in position during installation
Digital Thermostat (if selected): Allows adjustment of heat settings for added convenience
Conduit
Specifications:

Cable Type: Twin wire cable 100w/m²
Cable Thickness: 3mm
Mat Width: 500mm
Warranty: 25-year manufacturer warranty
Tested: 100% earth screened
Cold Tail Length: 2m
Certifications: UKCA and CE Approved
Installation Guide:

Divide the floor into rectangles and calculate the area to be heated, covering approximately 90% with the heating mat.
Lay insulation boards over concrete floors to minimize heat loss and ensure quicker warm-up times.
Start laying the mat close to the thermostat, ensuring the loops are equally spaced and attaching the mat to the subfloor using the provided tape.
Install an RCD fused spur to power the thermostatic controller/programmer and the mat system, and lay the temperature probe equidistant between two cable loops.
Lay a thin, self-leveling screed over the mat or trowel flexible tile adhesive directly over the mat before laying floor tiles. Allow the adhesive to cure before switching on the system.
Note: Alternative brands of heating mats may be supplied during stock shortages.

Experience the ultimate warmth and comfort throughout your living space with the Floorwarmers Electric Underfloor Heating Mat Kit 100W.

Installation Guide:

Divide the floor into rectangles and calculate the area to be heated, covering approximately 90% with the heating mat.
Lay insulation boards over concrete floors to minimize heat loss and ensure quicker warm-up times.
Start laying the mat close to the thermostat, ensuring the loops are equally spaced and attaching the mat to the subfloor using the provided tape.
Install an RCD fused spur to power the thermostatic controller/programmer and the mat system, and lay the temperature probe equidistant between two cable loops.
Lay a thin, self-leveling screed over the mat or trowel flexible tile adhesive directly over the mat before laying floor tiles. Allow the adhesive to cure before switching on the system.

product.name: ProWarm Foil Underfloor Heating Mat (Wood, Vinyl & Carpet) - 1.5M2
product.description:
Introducing the ProWarm Foil Underfloor Heating Mat - the perfect solution for those seeking a comfortable and efficient way to heat their wooden, vinyl, and carpet floors. This innovative product is designed to provide consistent and controllable warmth throughout any wooden flooring, from engineered boards to laminate and hardwood, as well as for vinyl or carpet floors.

The ProWarm Foil Underfloor Heating Mat is easy to install and is compatible with most types of floating floors, ensuring a quick and hassle-free installation process. It features a high-quality heating foil that provides reliable and even heat distribution throughout any floor.

Backed by an industry-leading lifetime warranty, the ProWarm Foil Underfloor Heating Mat provides peace of mind, ensuring you can enjoy the benefits of underfloor heating for years to come. Upgrade your home's heating system with the ProWarm Wood Underfloor Heating Mat and experience the ultimate in comfort and energy efficiency today.

Installation Requirements
These mats MUST be installed in conjunction with ProFoam or XPS Insulation.
When installing carpet/vinyl flooring, Heat-Pak Dual Overlay must also be used.
Ensure that the carpet and underlay combined tog value does not exceed 2.0. Note that in most cases, when carpet is laid, underfloor heating cannot be used as a primary heat source.
Kit Contents
ProWarm Foil Underfloor Heating Mat: Available in single, double, or triple mat configurations for areas over 12m2.
Digital Thermostat: Take control of your comfort with our range of programmable digital thermostats, each equipped with a floor temperature probe.
Adhesive Tape: Ensures a secure installation, keeping the mat or cable in place for a flawless finish.
Conduit: Adds an extra layer of durability and reliability to your heating system.
Specifications
The ProWarm Foil system is an ultra-thin electric radiant floor heating system primarily for use under laminate, engineered wood, glued hardwood, and other floating floors.
Made with Fluoropolymer insulated heating cables sandwiched between two layers of specially reinforced aluminum foil.
Uniform spacing of the heating elements ensures even heat distribution.
Available in heat outputs of 150 W/m2.
Hot and Cold lead junctions are uniquely designed for foolproof installation.
Meets all test requirements of IEC 60335 and SEMKO certified.
Cost-effective, flexible, and easy to install.
Provides close and uniform spacing of heating cables for higher comfort.
Wide range of heat loads and sizes ensure suitability to all kinds of floorings.

product.name: ProWarm Electric Underfloor Heating Cable - 0.9m2
product.description:
Experience the unbeatable warmth of the ProWarm Electric Underfloor Heating Cable 150W – your ticket to the coziest home ever! Perfect for any room, even those with tricky shapes, and compatible with various floor types, this all-in-one kit has everything you need for a reliable underfloor heating setup.

This exceptional heating cable is meticulously designed as a series-type cable, featuring a twin conductor along with a generous 3.0m cold lead on one side. Its construction includes a robust resistance heating wire enveloped in a primary insulation layer crafted from advanced fluoropolymer. Enhanced durability is achieved through a protective metal shielding layer, resulting in a resilient final outer sheath. Not only does it guarantee efficiency, but the ProWarm Underfloor Heating Cable achieves a remarkably sleek and compact outer diameter of just 2mm, offering both performance and sophistication.

With our CableSafe Guarantee, you can relax knowing that if you accidentally cut through the heating cable during installation, we'll replace it for free.

Setting it up is a breeze with our underfloor heating cable kits. Each kit comes neatly packed in one box, and the easy-to-follow instructions make installation a snap. Simply select a kit that covers about 90% of your floor space, order a bit less than you think you need, and you're good to go – our cables can't be cut or shortened.

Discover the comfort of the ProWarm Electric Underfloor Heating Cable 150W – simple, reliable, and bringing warmth to your home like never before. Say hello to cozy feet and a happier home!

Adhesive Tape: Holds the mat or cable securely in place during installation, providing added convenience and stability.
Conduit: Organizes and protects cables, ensuring a neat and professional installation.
Elevate your living space with the ProWarm Electric Underfloor Heating Cable 150W and enjoy the luxurious comfort of a perfectly heated floor. Experience the ProWarm difference today.

This innovative product is designed to provide consistent and controllable warmth throughout any wooden flooring, from engineered boards to laminate and hardwood, as well as for vinyl or carpet floors.

The ProWarm Foil Underfloor Heating Mat is easy to install and is compatible with most types of floating floors, ensuring a quick and hassle-free installation process. It features a high-quality heating foil that provides reliable and even heat distribution throughout any floor.

Backed by an industry-leading lifetime warranty, the ProWarm Foil Underfloor Heating Mat provides peace of mind, ensuring you can enjoy the benefits of underfloor heating for years to come. Upgrade your home's heating system with the ProWarm Wood Underfloor Heating Mat and experience the ultimate in comfort and energy efficiency today.

These mats MUST be installed in conjunction with ProFoam or XPS Insulation.

ProWarm Foil Underfloor Heating Mat: Available in single, double, or triple mat configurations for areas over 12m2.

Uniform spacing of the heating elements ensures even heat distribution.
Available in heat outputs of 150 W/m2.

The Plastic Pipe Leading Bend offers a reliable solution for creating tighter and more rigid pipe bends compared to the minimum allowed when the pipe is unsupported. It enhances flexibility and control during installation, ensuring optimal performance and efficiency in your piping system.

Improved Pipe Bend:
When working with plastic pipes, maintaining smooth flow is crucial to prevent any restrictions or kinks that may hinder liquid or gas flow. The Plastic Pipe Leading Bend allows for a seamless 90-degree bend without compromising pipe integrity, eliminating the risk of disruptive kinks that can cause pressure drops or blockages.

Enhanced Support and Stability:
Utilizing the Plastic Pipe Leading Bend ensures that your pipe system remains adequately supported and rigid at bends, even in areas with limited support. The bend provides extra reinforcement, minimizing the risk of sagging or deformation and maintaining a consistent flow profile throughout the piping network.

Easy Installation:
Designed for easy installation, the Plastic Pipe Leading Bend enables precise bends without requiring complex tools or techniques. Simply align the pipe with the bend and gradually guide it into the desired angle. The bend's flexibility and durability allow effortless shaping, saving time and effort during installation.

With the Plastic Pipe Leading Bend, you can ensure optimal flow, reduce the risk of kinks, and maintain a more secure and reliable piping system. Its ease of installation and superior performance make it an essential component for various plumbing applications.

product.name: ProWarm Premium 8mm Underfloor Heating Edge Insulation 50m
product.description:
ProWarm Premium 8mm Underfloor Heating Edge Insulation is an essential component designed specifically for screeded floors. It plays a crucial role in ensuring compliance with Building Regulations, minimizing heat loss, and facilitating proper expansion of the flooring system. Here's a breakdown of its features and benefits:

Effective Heat Loss Prevention: Acting as a barrier, the edge insulation reduces heat loss, enhancing the energy efficiency of the underfloor heating system.
Compliance with Building Regulations: Using edge insulation helps meet Building Regulations requirements, ensuring a safe and efficient installation.
Expansion Allowance: The insulation strips allow for the free expansion of the floor screed, preventing issues caused by thermal expansion and contraction.
Easy Installation: With self-adhesive backing, the edge insulation can be easily fitted around walls, columns, steps, and doorways. A staple gun can also be used for secure installation.
Trimming Capability: Surplus insulation above the finished floor screed can be easily trimmed for a clean, professional finish once the screed has cured.
High-Quality Standards: ProWarm Underfloor Heating Edge Insulation is KIWA/KOMO approved, WRAS approved, and manufactured in accordance with BS EN ISO 9002 standards. These certifications ensure strict quality and performance standards are met.
Experience the benefits of ProWarm Underfloor Heating Edge Insulation 50m, including easy installation, compliance with regulations, and reliable performance for optimal heat distribution and efficiency in your underfloor heating system. Follow the provided guidelines for proper installation to enjoy the benefits of a well-insulated and energy-efficient underfloor heating system.

product.name: Plumbright 0.16 Litre Shock Arrestor PV016E
product.description:
This Altecnic 0.16 Litre Shock Arrestor is specially designed to prevent the long term effects of water hammer, across a number of appliances & systems. Those would include Boilers, Sinks and Washing machines. 

The Altecnic Shock Arrestor consists of a Pressure Vessel, divided into two chambers by a flexible rubber membrane or diaphragm. 

A shock arrestor works on a heating system by using a compressible gas separated by a diaphragm to cushion sudden pressure spikes. These spikes in pressure are absorbed from WAter Hammer and thermal expansion, protecting pipes and components from damage and noise. When water suddenly stops, the kinetic energy creates a shockwave which the arrestor absorbs before it travels down pipework, preventing expansion stress

ProWarm ProFoam Boards are tailored to provide efficient insulation for our underwood heating and carpet heating mat systems, offering a budget-friendly solution without compromising on performance.

Compatibility with Underwood Heating Systems: Designed to seamlessly integrate with underwood heating systems, ensuring effective heat distribution and cost savings.
Underlay for Wooden Floors: These boards not only insulate but also serve as high-quality underlay for wooden floors, enhancing comfort and durability.

product.name: Ultra Prolevel Ultimate - Single Part Smoothing Underlayment - 20kg
product.description:
UltraTile Pro-Level Ultimate is a cutting-edge solution specifically engineered for use with underfloor heating systems. Its advanced formulation enables it to be applied on virtually any subfloor, including various substrates. This semi-rapid curing product allows floor coverings to be installed on top in as little as 4 hours, facilitating quick project completion. Pro-Level Ultimate is a high-performance, free-flowing single-part smoothing levelling compound, incorporating Ecosphere technology made with 20% recycled material for improved application and reduced environmental impact.

Key Features:

Designed for Underfloor Heating: Tailored to meet the demands of underfloor heating systems, ensuring compatibility and optimal performance in heated environments.
Apply Floor Coverings After 4 Hours: Offers fast curing properties, allowing floor coverings to be applied just 4 hours after application, reducing project timelines.
Suitable for Use Over Old Adhesive Residues: Can be applied over old adhesive residues, providing versatility and saving time on substrate preparation.
Contains 20% Recycled Material: Incorporates Ecosphere technology with 20% recycled material, promoting sustainability and reducing environmental impact.
Excellent Adhesion to Almost All Substrates: Ensures strong adhesion to a wide range of substrates, enhancing reliability and performance in diverse applications.
No Need to Prime (Under Certain Conditions): Eliminates the need for priming under certain conditions, streamlining the application process and saving time and effort.
Specifications:

Screed Classification: CT-C12-F5, indicating its suitability for various flooring applications.
Working Time at 20°C: Provides approximately 45 minutes of working time at 20°C, allowing sufficient time for application and levelling.
Walk-On Hardness Time at 20°C: Achieves walk-on hardness in 2-2.5 hours at 20°C, facilitating continued work progress.
Ready to Receive Floor Coverings: Ready to receive floor coverings in 4 hours with a 3mm application, enabling timely completion of projects.
Compressive Strength (N/mm²): Offers impressive compressive strength, with values of 10 N/mm² at 1 day, 12 N/mm² at 7 days, and 15 N/mm² at 28 days, ensuring durability and long-term performance.
Flexural Strength (N/mm²): Exhibits flexural strength values of 2 N/mm² at 1 day, 3 N/mm² at 7 days, and 5 N/mm² at 28 days, further enhancing its structural integrity.
Coverage:

Applied Thickness: Provides coverage per unit for various thicknesses, ranging from 3mm to 30mm, offering flexibility to meet project requirements.
Cleaning, Storage, and Shelf Life:

Cleaning: Tools should be thoroughly cleaned with water to remove excess material immediately after use, ensuring proper maintenance and longevity.
Storage: Store in a dry place at temperatures between 5°C and 30°C to maintain product integrity and performance.
Shelf Life: Under the specified storage conditions, the product has a shelf life of 8 months, ensuring product usability and reliability. High temperatures and humidity may affect shelf life and should be avoided for optimal performance.
Enhance your flooring projects with UltraTile Pro-Level Ultimate, a high-performance solution designed to meet the rigorous demands of underfloor heating installations while promoting sustainability and environmental responsibility.

product.name: Hansgrohe Rebris S Single Lever Basin Mixer 80 Coolstart Without Waste Set Chrome 72514000
product.description: Hansgrohe designed the Rebris S 80 single lever basin mixer with rounded contours and a shiny chrome finish that wipes clean easily. An internal ceramic mixer system regulates flow rate and water temperature. The integrated CoolStart function delivers cold water while the lever remains centred, activating hot supply only upon leftward rotation. Built-in EcoSmart technology restricts the water flow rate to a maximum of 5 litres per minute under high pressure conditions. An AirPower aerator infuses the water stream with air to produce a soft, low-splash jet. You can unscrew and descale this aerator using a standard coin without requiring additional tools. Installers can adjust an internal temperature limiter during fitting to prevent scalding from excessively hot water. Flexible DN15 connection hoses simplify attachment to standard pipework. This basin tap operates alongside continuous flow heating units.

product.description:
More space even in small bathrooms – without drilling: WallStoris toilet brush holder
The WallStoris brush holder is part of the smart accessories from hansgrohe. Finally, there is an individual and stylish solution for storing all the items in the bathroom, that looks good and is as durable as it is flexible. Your biggest advantage: more space even in that small bathroom! The WallStoris toilet brush holder is just as versatile as the rest of the accessory range: it can be free-standing, traditionally fastened with screws or reliably glued. The adhesive connection can be removed again later without any residue. This is particularly practical in a rented apartment and wherever drilling into tiles needs to be avoided. The necessary adhesive is included in the delivery and holds all tiles, metal and glass surfaces.
Flexible, because life happens

product.name: Ideal Standard Ceratherm ALU+ Shower System with exposed single lever shower mixer 260mm 2 function shower head 100mm 2 function handspray and 2 shelves silk black BD579XG
product.description:
This elegant Ideal Standard shower system offers a complete modern showering solution with its exposed single lever mixer and striking silk black finish. Designed by the esteemed Palomba Serafini Associati, this collection showcases a beautiful design language that combines elongated rectangular shapes with circular elements to bring a playful yet sophisticated aesthetic to your bathroom. The silk black finish is one of three gorgeous contemporary options available in this range, giving your wetroom or enclosure a bold, modern appearance that stands out.

Beyond its striking visual appeal, the unit is packed with practical features. The design incorporates integrated shelving, providing a convenient pair of storage shelves to keep your shampoo, soap, and other daily washing essentials neatly organised and close to hand. Crucially, the construction contains absolutely no lead, chrome, or nickel. Instead, the manufacturer utilises high-quality aluminium that is composed of eighty-four percent recycled material, making it an eco-conscious choice that is also remarkably easy to recycle when it eventually reaches the end of its lifespan.

For a highly satisfying and tailored washing experience, the system comes equipped with a generous 260mm shower head that boasts dual spray functions, allowing you to choose the perfect flow for your mood. This is accompanied by a flexible handspray that also features dual functions, which is perfect for targeted rinsing or cleaning the enclosure.

To ensure your showering experience is always safe and comfortable, the unit features a high-performance PreciTherm cartridge. This advanced technology maintains a perfectly constant water temperature even in rough environments where water pressure fluctuates. For added peace of mind, especially in family homes, there is an optional temperature limiter that can be configured to prevent the water from getting too hot. This combination of beautiful design, practical storage, safety features, and strong environmental credentials makes this an outstanding choice for any modern home.

Built to ERP standards, the unit houses a patented heat exchanger inside a no-maintenance housing rated to IP45. Combustion uses Riello low-NOx burner technology. Each unit includes over £250 worth of factory-fitted accessories, featuring an Adey Magnaclean Pro 2 filter. product.name: Warmflow Agentis Boiler House 33kW Heat Only Oil Boiler B33
product.description:
This high-efficiency oil boiler from Warmflow offers an exceptional heating solution designed specifically for boiler house installations. Encased in a distinctive blue outer cabinet, this unit features a remarkably efficient heat-exchanger system designed to capture maximum warmth. Homeowners will appreciate the ErP A rated efficiency, which helps to reduce household energy bills and lower carbon emissions over time.

At the heart of this appliance is the newest low NOx combustion system by Riello, which ensures compliance with modern environmental standards. This advanced burner setup keeps the appliance running with minimal noise, making it a peaceful addition to any household utility area. It represents a premier selection for properties relying on oil-fired heating.

To simplify the installation process for installers, the assembly is completely wired at the factory, including both the integrated burner and the control thermostat. It also comes equipped with a pre-installed condensate trap directly from the production line. Furthermore, the primary flow and return ports are situated on the top panel to ensure straightforward pipework routing.

The physical design is highly practical, featuring a front-facing layout where components can be effortlessly reached when routine maintenance or servicing is required. For ultimate peace of mind, the manufacturer provides a standard two-year guarantee with this product. This coverage can be extended to five years, provided the appliance is set up by a registered Connect Scheme installer and fitted with an appropriate system filter.

product.name: Warmflow Agentis Internal 21kW System Oil Boiler I21S
product.description: Warmflow has engineered the Agentis I21S internal system oil boiler with a 21 kW output, designed for direct placement in kitchen and utility areas. Achieving ErP A rated efficiency, this unit incorporates a patented heat exchanger to ensure high operational performance. A factory-fitted Grundfos UPM3 FLEX circulating pump is pre-installed within the system. Combustion is handled by a Riello burner featuring low-NOx technology to restrict environmental emissions. A white casing houses the internal components to sit neatly alongside existing household appliances.

product.name: Warmflow Agentis External Pro 26kW System Oil Boiler E26SPRO
product.description:
This twenty-six kilowatt outdoor system oil boiler from Warmflow delivers a high-performance heating solution designed for external installation. By placing the appliance outside, this system helps to free up valuable floor space inside the home while keeping any operational noise completely outdoors. The unit is built with an ErP A-rated efficiency level to ensure low running costs and reduced fuel consumption for the end user. 

To protect the internal components from harsh weather conditions, the boiler is enclosed in a specialised IP-rated outer casing that requires no regular maintenance or painting. Internally, the appliance is equipped with a patented heat exchanger that delivers exceptional thermal transfer rates. 

For heating engineers, this professional model is supplied with over two hundred and fifty pounds worth of factory-fitted accessories, which significantly reduces on-site installation time and complexity. Among these pre-installed accessories is an Adey Magnaclean Pro magnetic system filter, designed to capture magnetic and non-magnetic debris from the system water. Additionally, the factory-fitted package includes a high-quality Crossland oil filter to protect the burner from fuel contaminants, alongside a Teddington fire valve for critical safety protection. 

To complete the installation setup, two bottles of chemical water inhibitor are provided in the box, allowing the installer to treat the system immediately upon filling. Combustion is managed by a reliable burner incorporating Riello low NOx technology, which ensures the unit operates with minimal nitrogen oxide emissions to meet current environmental standards. This combination of pre-fitted components and high-efficiency operation makes the boiler an excellent choice for modern domestic heating upgrades.

product.name: Hansgrohe Ecostat Shower Thermostat Comfort For Exposed Installation Matt Black 13116670
product.description:
Hansgrohe designed this exposed shower thermostat with a matt black finish and SoftCube edges to suit modern bathroom architecture. Engineered for exposed installation, the unit connects directly to DN 15 S-connections to supply a single shower head. Two ergonomic dials control temperature and volume, maintaining the chosen water temperature through an internal thermostatic mixer.

At 3 bar water pressure, the outlet delivers a maximum flow rate of 17 litres per minute. An integrated EcoStop button restricts the default volume to 10 litres per minute to reduce water consumption. For user safety, an optional 40°C SafetyStop override button prevents accidental adjustments to higher temperatures. 

An adjustable temperature limiter provides thermal protection against scalding. An internal non-return valve stops wastewater from flowing back into the clean drinking water pipeline. A built-in silencer absorbs water movement noise to ensure quiet operation.

product.description:
The shower thermostat for a stylish and safe family bathroom
The Ecostat E by hansgrohe is perfect for families with children as it makes showering safer and more convenient. The smart flow of water always keeps the surface of the thermostatic mixer nice and cool when showering (CoolContact) to reliably protect the hands of all from scalding.
The selected temperature is also kept constant as far as is possible, as the elegant exposed installation thermostatic mixer kicks into action automatically and instantly when the pressure fluctuates.     •  Super-silent: A built-in silencer reduces the sounds of the water

This stylish Hansgrohe shower system combines a bath filler, hand shower, and a generous overhead shower in a striking matt black finish to modernise your bathroom setup. The trendy matt black colourway provides a bold contrast that coordinates beautifully with contemporary architectural styles. Designed with geometric lines, the Vernis Shape collection introduces a premium aesthetic to your home even if you are working with a smaller budget. This high-quality bathroom upgrade ensures you can enjoy a luxurious showering experience every single day.

The set features a 240 mm square overhead spray that covers you in a rich, relaxing flow of water. This large spray face delivers what the manufacturer calls XXL Performance, dispersing the water evenly to create a truly pampering environment. It is easy to switch between the bath tap and the shower head with a simple movement of the integrated diverter, requiring very little effort to change your water path.

At the heart of the system is a reliable thermostatic mixer which ensures a stable water temperature. It works dynamically to prevent sudden cold shocks or hot spikes, even if another household member runs a tap elsewhere in your home. For added peace of mind, a safety lock mechanism is set at a comfortable limit, preventing the water from becoming too hot unless you manually press a release button to select a higher temperature.

The package includes a flexible shower hose measuring 1.6 metres in length, which gives you excellent freedom of movement. A built-in holder keeps your hand-held spray neatly stored and always within easy reach. Cleaning is kept simple because the silicone outlets across the spray face can be wiped clean to remove limescale deposits quickly. You can also adjust the angle of the main overhead spray to suit your personal preference. Installation is straightforward because the unit connects directly to standard S-type wall fittings, meaning there is no need to expose hidden pipework behind the tiles. Furthermore, Hansgrohe guarantees that replacement components will remain obtainable for fifteen years following the discontinuation of the collection.

This Drayton thermostatic radiator valve and lockshield pack provides homeowners with an efficient way to control heating in individual rooms. The system features a highly sensitive liquid-filled sensor that reacts quickly to temperature changes in your home. This rapid response ensures your rooms stay at a consistent, comfortable temperature without wasting energy, helping to manage your household heating bills more effectively.

Homeowners can enjoy peace of mind thanks to the double gland seal design. This specialised engineering feature significantly reduces the risk of water leaks around the valve spindle, ensuring long-term reliability and protecting your flooring from potential water damage. When it is time to decorate or perform maintenance, the positive off position allows you to isolate the radiator completely. This means you can temporarily remove the radiator for painting or cleaning without having to drain the entire central heating system. To safeguard your home during the coldest months, the valve includes integrated frost protection that automatically opens to prevent pipes from freezing. It also features range limiting, allowing you to set maximum and minimum temperatures to prevent accidental overheating.

product.name: Unilift AP124004A1 Grey Waste P 96404179
product.description: Grundfos Unilift AP12 pumps are designed for pumping clean non-aggressive water and drainage- and greywater with particles up to 12mm. The pumps are suitable for temporary as well as permanent free-standing installations. Vertical single-stage submersible centrifugal drainage pumps with a vertical discharge port, designed for free-standing installation in wells pits, and tanks. Grundfos UNILIFT AP12.40.04.A1 1x230V 10m pump is a single-stage, submersible centrifugal pump. The pump can be installed horizontal/vertical and has discharge port with a nominal diameter of 40 mm, and has automatic operation. All Unilift AP12 pumps have a threaded vertical discharge port. The pump is available for automatic as well as manual operation and can be installed in a permanent installation or used as a portable pump. The stainless steel pump sleeve is made in one piece, and equipped with an insulated carrying handle. The suction strainer is clipped on to the pump housing for easy removal when maintenance is required. The strainer prevents the passage of large solids, and ensures a slow flow into the pump. As a result, most impurities are prevented from entering the pump. The stainless steel pump housing is fitted with an internal riser pipe ensuring high efficiency. The riser pipe has a number of holes enabling efficient cooling of the motor during operation. The cable entry is of the socket and plug connection type for quick and easy dismantling. The stainless steel shaft rotates in maintenance-free prelubricated ball bearings. The stainless steel impeller is a semi-open impeller with L-shaped blades and a clearance of 12 mm. The blades are curved backwards to reduce any harmful effect from solid particles and to minimise power consumption. The shaft seal is a combination of a mechanical, bellows shaft seal and a lip seal with 60 ml oil between. Seal faces are made of silicone carbide. The motor is a single-phase asynchronous dry-rotor motor. This single-phase motor incorporates thermal overload protection, and requires no additional motor protection.

product.name: Iskra MT174 Three Phase Electricity Meter MT174-DC-MID
product.description:
MT174 Electronic three-phase meter designed for measurement and registration of active, reactive and apparent energy and demand in three-phase four-wire networks.

Metering and technical properties of the meters comply with the EN 50470-1 and -3 European standards for active energy meters, classes A and B, as well as with the IEC 62053-21 and IEC 62052-11 international standards for electronic meters of active energy for classes 1 and 2, and optionally with the IEC 62053-23 international standard for electronic meters of reactive energy for classes 2 and 3.

Built-in time-switch complies with the IEC 62054-21 and IEC 62052-21 standards and enables energy registration in up to four tariffs.

Meter software complies with WELMEC 7.2 Issue 1 Software Guide (Measuring Instruments Directive 2004/22/EC). 
MT174 meters are designed for mechanical environment M1, electromagnetic environment E2 and climatic environment -40°C … +60°C, relative humidity 95% non-condensing, closed location.

product.name: Reliance RWC 1/2 MBSP x 15mm CPT15 Pressure & Temperature Relief Valve 7 Bar PTEM540010
product.description:
The Reliance CPT15 pressure and temperature relief valve has been designed to provide protection against over pressurization, which can occur within an unvented hot water cylinder system if the input temperature controls fail. The CPT15 pressure & temperature relief valve is designed to be fitted in the upper portion of the unvented cylinder as this is where the hottest system temperatures will be found.

 

If the system temperature rises beyond 95° C, the wax mixture within the element of the temperature probe will expand, causing the valve to lift off its seat and relieve water to waste. If the water pressure increases (without temperature increase) the CPT15 temperature & pressure relief valve will stay closed until the set pressure of the relief mechanism is reached, at which point the valve will open to relieve the excess pressure build-up.

product.name: Worcester Bosch Heat Exchanger 8716122564
product.description: The Worcester Bosch Heat Exchanger 8716122564 is a genuine Worcester Bosch spare part with a Worcester Bosch manufacturer's guarantee. The Heat Exchanger is a vital component that facilitates the transfer of heat from the burner to the water within a heating system. These parts are categorised into two separate types, the Primary Heat Exchanger and the Secondary Heat Exchanger. The Primary is found within almost all boiler systems whereas a Secondary is only found within Combination systems to allow the heat to be transferred between the two closed systems.

With its seamless installation process, thermostat or timer mode options, mesh networking technology, and intuitive user interface, the neoStat V2 offers convenience and flexibility for efficient heating control.

Key Features:

Seamless Installation: Designed to replace an existing three-wire thermostat, the neoStat ensures quick and hassle-free installation. Once connected to the neoHub, you can enjoy remote control functionality for added convenience.
Thermostat or Timer Mode: Configure the neoStat to function as a thermostat or a timer, allowing comprehensive control over not only your heating but also other devices such as towel rails or lighting.
Mesh Networking: Utilizes mesh networking technology for reliable and scalable communication with the neoHub. Each mains-powered neoStat acts as a signal repeater, ensuring robust connectivity throughout your home.
Easy Navigation: Features an intuitive user interface with easy-to-navigate programming options. All settings and functions are conveniently accessible at the bottom of the backlit display, providing a user-friendly experience.
Self Learning Preheat: Calculates the optimal heat-up time to ensure your home is warm when you wake up or return home. Continuously adjusts this preheat time based on seasonal changes, helping you save energy and money.
Programmable Options: Offers various programming modes including 5/2 day, 7-day, or 24-hour programming, allowing customization of your heating schedule to suit your lifestyle.
Holiday Function: Includes a holiday function to set a specific temperature while you're away, conserving energy without compromising comfort.
Temperature Hold: Locks the thermostat at a specific temperature for consistent heating according to your preference.
App Control: Can be controlled remotely through a dedicated mobile application, providing flexibility to manage your heating system from anywhere in the house.
Air Sensor Connection: Supports an air sensor connection for accurate temperature monitoring and control.
Floor Sensing Mode: Operates in floor sensing mode with the optional floor probe (sold separately), ensuring precise temperature control for underfloor heating systems.

Supply: Powered by 230v AC.
Dimensions: Compact size with dimensions of 85x85x13mm.
Temperature Range: 5-35°C.

Remove the screw from the bottom face of the thermostat and carefully separate the front half from the back plate.
Place the thermostat front somewhere safe and terminate the thermostat as shown in the wiring diagram.
Screw the thermostat back plate securely into the back box.
Clip the front of the thermostat onto the back plate, securing it in place with the retaining screw.

product.description:
The HomeKit-Enabled Heatmiser neoKit 2 includes 1 neoStat, 1 neoStat-hw, and a neoHub (2nd generation), allowing you to take control of your heating and hot water from anywhere.

Heatmiser is proud to be one of the very first heating control manufacturers to support HomeKit, the home automation platform from Apple.

HomeKit support offers:

Siri Voice Control: With HomeKit, you can ask Siri to set your Neo in each room to the desired temperature.
Control from inside iOS 10: HomeKit accessories, including Neo, can be controlled straight from the Control Centre in iOS 10. This means you no longer need to open the Neo app to make a quick temperature adjustment.
Automation Rules: Rules can be set up that can trigger Neo and your other HomeKit accessories. There are many triggers, but it could be when you arrive home, open a window or door, or at sunset.
Scenes: A scene on HomeKit works across all of your HomeKit devices, setting up your Smart Home just got easier. A Movie Time scene could raise your Neo temperature, lock the Doors, and lower the blinds. Now that's smart!
System Features

HomeKit Enabled: The Secure Smart Home platform from Apple.
Geo-Location Facility: Using your mobile phone position, Neo will automatically turn the heating off in your home when the last person has left and back on again when the first person is on their way home.
Apple Watch Compatible: Control your Neo System from your Apple Watch.
IFTTT Compatible: Connecting Heatmiser to your Digital World.
UK/Euro/Australian Adaptor Included
Flexible Programming: Your neoStat can be set up to work in 5/2 day, 7 day, or 24-hour mode. 5/2 is ideal for those with different weekday/weekend schedules. 7-day is great for those with different schedules each day, and 24-hour mode offers the same settings for every day - so perfect for those at home most days.
Comfortable Temperature: 4 Comfort levels per day, so you can, for example, have your home warm when you wake, a little lower while you are out at work, warmer in the evening while you relax, and reduced further throughout the night while you sleep.
Easy Away: Turning your heating off shouldn't be difficult - if it is, you are less likely to do it. The easy Away feature in Neo allows you to switch your home heating off from anywhere. Even in Away mode, we have your home covered providing frost protection in your home.
Convenient Profiles: Re-programming your comfort levels as and when your schedule changes is a thing of the past. A profile is a set of comfort levels that you can activate at any time from the app.
Always Updated: Your neoHub will automatically download feature enhancements and bug fixes, automatically updating all of your neoStats.
Clock Sync: Your neoHub will obtain the time from the internet and will automatically correct your neoStats based on your location.
Open API: The open API allows third-party developers to integrate with the Heatmiser neoHub.

product.name: ProWarm Tacker Staples - 40mm x 300
product.description:
The ProWarm Tacker Staples offer an optimal solution for securely installing pipework directly on top of insulation. Crafted with convenience and efficiency in mind, these 40/55mm pipe staples are available in boxes of 150 or 300, ensuring an ample supply for your installation needs.

Before purchasing the staples, it's crucial to check the depth of your insulation to ensure proper compatibility. This precaution ensures that the staples are suitable for your specific installation requirements, providing a reliable and long-lasting solution.

Installing the ProWarm Tacker Staples is straightforward, offering flexibility and convenience. They can be easily fixed by hand or with the use of a combi tacker, making them suitable for both small-scale projects and large areas where many staples need to be installed. The combi tacker option is particularly advantageous, saving time and effort, especially during extensive installations.

Known for their durability and reliability, ProWarm Tacker Staples are crafted from high-quality materials, ensuring a secure and long-lasting installation. With their sturdy construction, these staples effectively hold pipework in place, ensuring proper alignment and preventing any shifting or movement over time.

When it comes to securing pipework on insulation, trust the ProWarm Tacker Staples to deliver outstanding performance. Their ease of installation, compatibility with insulation, and reliable grip make them the ideal choice for any project.

Specifications
Length: 40mm
Width: 33mm
Depth: 6mm
Weight: 0.474kg
Installation
Once the pipework is in place, the staples can be easily pushed into the insulation by hand or using a combi tacker gun. The barbed ridges will hold the pipework in place while the final screed is applied.

These staples are suitable for use with 15m/16mm Pipe.

product.name: ProWarm Underfloor Heating Floor Probe
product.description:
The ProWarm Floor Probe is an essential component designed for use with all of our digital thermostats, providing accurate and reliable temperature sensing for your underfloor heating system.

Ensure Reliable Temperature Sensing
Whether you need an additional or replacement floor temperature probe, the ProWarm Floor Probe is the ideal solution. It ensures precise measurement of the floor temperature, allowing your digital thermostat to effectively control and maintain the desired heating levels.

Proactive Backup Probe
Installing the ProWarm Floor Probe as a reserve probe during the initial heating installation is a smart precautionary measure. In the unlikely event of a failure with the original probe, having a backup probe in place ensures uninterrupted functionality of your underfloor heating system.

Long Length for Versatile Installation
The ProWarm Floor Probe comes with a generous 3-meter length, providing flexibility in installation. This allows you to position the probe conveniently and accurately in your desired location, ensuring optimal temperature sensing.

Precision and Accuracy
The ProWarm Floor Probe features a resistance of 10k Ohms at 25 degrees Celsius. With its reliable performance and precise temperature measurement, you can trust that your underfloor heating system will operate efficiently and maintain comfortable warmth in your living spaces.

Compatibility
The ProWarm Floor Probe is compatible with all of our digital thermostats, ensuring seamless integration and reliable temperature control for your underfloor heating system.

Trustworthy Quality
At ProWarm, we prioritize quality and reliability. Our Floor Probe is manufactured to the highest standards, ensuring durability and long-lasting performance for years to come.

product.name: UltraFloor Prime IT Multi-Surface Primer
product.description:
Prime IT MSP is a versatile, water-based acrylic primer, sealer, and bonding aid suitable for a wide range of substrates, both porous and non-porous.

Key Features:

Moisture Tolerant: Ideal for use on substrates with varying moisture levels, ensuring reliable performance even in challenging conditions.
Enhances Adhesion: Improves bonding between substrates and subsequent materials, promoting strong and durable adhesion.
Reduces Pinholing: Helps minimize the occurrence of pinholes, ensuring a smooth and even surface for subsequent applications.
High Coverage: Covers up to 200m² at a 3:1 dilution ratio, providing excellent value for large-scale projects.
Can Be Used as a Curing Agent: Functions as a curing agent, facilitating the proper curing and bonding of subsequent materials.
Size: Available in a 5-liter container, suitable for both small-scale and large-scale applications.
Calculation Guidelines:
For porous surfaces: Apply one coat at a 3:1 dilution ratio, followed by one coat at a 1:1 dilution ratio.
For non-porous surfaces: Apply one neat coat of MSP.

product.name: ProWarm BACKER-PRO Tile Backer Board 50mm
product.description:
ProWarm BACKER-PRO insulation boards offer superior waterproofing and heat insulation for underfloor heating and tile applications. These high-quality extruded polystyrene panels, reinforced with fiberglass mesh on both sides, complement our under tile heating cables and mats (not suitable for underwood systems).

Key Features:

Superior Waterproof Surface: Provides a durable, waterproof foundation for securely fixing wall or floor tiles, ensuring long-lasting performance and protection against moisture.
Outstanding Heat Insulation: With excellent thermal conductivity (0.033 W/mK), these boards enhance underfloor heating system efficiency, reducing heat-up time and minimizing running costs for optimal comfort and energy savings.
Wide Range of Thickness Options: Available in 6mm, 10mm, 12.5mm, 20mm, 30mm, and 50mm thicknesses, offering versatility to accommodate various installation requirements and insulation needs.
Approved by Tile Adhesive Manufacturer Instarmac -Ultra: Rigorously tested and approved by Instarmac -Ultra, ensuring compatibility and reliability.
Excellent Sound Insulation: Effectively reduces impact sound, creating a quieter and more comfortable environment.
Easy Installation: Can be easily cut with a knife, eliminating the need for complex tools like a jigsaw. Suitable for installation on both floors and walls.
Dimensional Stability: Waterproof and exhibits excellent dimensional stability, maintaining integrity and performance even in wet room environments.
Enhance your underfloor heating and tiling projects with ProWarm BACKER-PRO insulation boards. Their exceptional waterproofing, insulation properties, and ease of installation make them the ideal choice for creating a reliable and efficient heating system with a durable tile surface.

Available Thicknesses: 6mm, 10mm, 12.5mm, 20mm, 30mm, 50mm
Waterproof: Yes
Thermal Conductivity: 0.033 W/mK
Sound Insulation: Yes
Installation Method: Cutting with a knife, suitable adhesives for concrete or wooden subfloors
Please note: The color of the polystyrene may vary depending on the batch. The boards are not stamped with 'ProWarm', and the image is for advertising purposes only.

product.name: ProWarm Ultra Prime Surface Conditioner 0.5L
product.description:
Ultraprime is an acrylic surface conditioner designed to enhance bonding on various building substrates, including plaster, timber, brick, and blockwork (porous surfaces). Here are its key features and specifications:

Versatile and Durable: Suitable for a variety of substrates, Ultraprime offers durability and reliability in bonding applications.
Increases Bond Strength: Enhances the adhesion of subsequent layers, ensuring a strong and lasting bond between materials.
Improves Water Resistance: Provides improved resistance to water penetration, enhancing the longevity of bonded surfaces.
Improves Flexibility: Enhances the flexibility of bonded surfaces, reducing the risk of cracking or damage due to movement.
Seals and Primes: Functions as both a sealer and primer, preparing the surface for further treatment or finishing.
Use with Porous Substrates: Specifically formulated for use on porous substrates such as plaster, timber, brick, and blockwork.
Specifications:

Packaging: Available in 0.5 Litres containers.
Coverage: Can cover up to 7m² per coat, depending on the porosity of the substrate.
Storage: Store in airtight containers between 5°C and 30°C. Protect from frost to maintain product integrity.
Shelf Life: Has a shelf life of 6 months under the specified storage conditions.
Ultraprime offers a reliable solution for enhancing bond strength and improving water resistance on various building substrates. With its versatility, durability, and ease of use, it is an ideal choice for bonding applications in construction and renovation projects.

product.name: ProWarm ProGrid+ Heating Mat - 1m
product.description:
The ProWarm ProGrid+ Heating Mat represents a cutting-edge solution designed to simplify the installation process of loose electric underfloor heating cables. Bid farewell to cumbersome installations and embrace efficiency and convenience.

Crafted with innovation in mind, the ProGrid+ matting features a unique grid system tailored to effortlessly accommodate the electric heating cable within its grooves. No more wrestling with tape or fixings – the pre-spaced design ensures precise placement, enabling users to achieve their desired heat output per square meter effortlessly.

But there's more. The ProGrid+ matting not only houses the cable but also acts as a robust decoupling membrane. This critical feature serves as a shield against reflective cracking, a common issue caused by shrinkage cracks, board joints, and lateral movement. With ProGrid+, rest assured that your underfloor heating system will remain resilient and durable over time.

ProWarm Electric Underfloor Heating cable kits are known for their reliability and effectiveness. Compatible with various floor coverings, including tiles, these kits offer versatility to suit a range of installation needs. Need guidance on installation methods? Our team is here to assist – just give us a call, and we'll walk you through the process.

Experience the future of underfloor heating installation with ProWarm ProGrid+. Embrace efficiency, reliability, and unmatched convenience.

Please Note: For use with either ProWarm ProGrid+ Electric Underfloor Heating Cable 150W or the Warmup DCM-PRO Cable. For use with normal loose cable systems, closest spacings are 60mm and will not work for 200w/m².

product.name: ProWarm BACKER-PRO Tile Backer Board - 12mm
product.description:

These high-quality extruded polystyrene panels, reinforced with fiberglass mesh on both sides, complement our under tile heating cables and mats (not suitable for underwood systems).

Superior Waterproof Surface: Provides a durable, waterproof foundation for securely fixing wall or floor tiles, ensuring long-lasting performance and protection against moisture.
Outstanding Heat Insulation: With excellent thermal conductivity (0.033 W/mK), these boards enhance underfloor heating system efficiency, reducing heat-up time and minimizing running costs for optimal comfort and energy savings.
Wide Range of Thickness Options: Available in 6mm, 10mm, 12.5mm, 20mm, 30mm, and 50mm thicknesses, offering versatility to accommodate various installation requirements and insulation needs.
Approved by Tile Adhesive Manufacturer Instarmac -Ultra: Rigorously tested and approved by Instarmac -Ultra, ensuring compatibility and reliability.
Excellent Sound Insulation: Effectively reduces impact sound, creating a quieter and more comfortable environment.
Easy Installation: Can be easily cut with a knife, eliminating the need for complex tools like a jigsaw. Suitable for installation on both floors and walls.
Dimensional Stability: Waterproof and exhibits excellent dimensional stability, maintaining integrity and performance even in wet room environments.
Enhance your underfloor heating and tiling projects with ProWarm BACKER-PRO insulation boards. Their exceptional waterproofing, insulation properties, and ease of installation make them the ideal choice for creating a reliable and efficient heating system with a durable tile surface.

product.name: Reliance Water Controls Water Shock Arrestor 12.7mm Xves050000
product.description: Shock arrestors are used to prevent water hammer. Water hammer is caused by shock waves running through the water system which create noise, or in severe cases pipe movement within the system. Reverberations are a series of shock waves in quick succession. The pressure wave in such circumstances can be up to three times greater than the standing pressure. Water hammer occurs when the flow rate is suddenly changed e.g. when a valve is quickly closed quarter turn lever operated taps or solenoid valves are two of the main culprits. Reverberations occur when system components have moving parts which respond to an initial shock wave by trying to open or close. The Reliance Water Controls shock arrestor is a mini expansion vessel which works by absorbing the shock wave from the fitting so that it does not travel through the system and cause noise. The closer the shock arrestor is installed to the fitting the better.

product.name: GivEnergy All in One Gateway
product.description:
By purchasing the additional Giv-Gateway, the
All in One can provide whole house backup in the
event of a grid failure. The Giv-Gateway provides seamless switching between grid
and battery ensuring that your property is always powered.
The Giv-Gateway also facilitates a connection point for your
solar PV system by allowing it to continue to generate
energy even without a grid supply.

Social Housing Projects where smaller storage
capacity is required to start that can then be
increased over time. Due to its small and compact design, it is suitable for

household.

locations. The battery chemistry does not contain any

product.name: GivEnergy 6.0KW / 13.5kWh All in One Energy Storage
product.description:
British manufacturer GivEnergy designed the GIV-AIO-13.5-AC system with a 6.0kW power output and 13.5kWh usable capacity for residential and commercial solar PV setups. Running on-grid, it delivers 7.2kW peak power alongside current solar panel generation. 

The modular casing contains four removable battery units to simplify handling during installation. For larger properties, multiple units can be fitted in parallel to increase overall storage capacity. 

Wiring the unit with a GivEnergy Gateway provides off-grid backup power to the whole house during grid failures. Compatibility with flexible rate tariffs lets you charge the unit off-peak when electricity rates are lower, then discharge during peak demand. This grid services ready system also enables energy suppliers and aggregators to pay users for reducing electrical usage at specified times.

product.name: GivEnergy 5.0kW Singler Phase Hybrid Inverter Generation 3
product.description: The GivEnergy GIV-HY5.0 G3 is a single-phase generation 3 hybrid unit that combines a solar inverter with a battery inverter to process up to 5.0kW of power. Direct connection to solar panels allows this unit to convert photovoltaic generation for immediate property use or divert excess production into storage. Storing surplus power during daylight hours lowers grid exports, while discharging battery power to meet household loads reduces grid imports. Built with a discharge rate reaching 3.6kW, the system supports flexible rate tariffs by charging off-peak and discharging at peak usage times. An integrated network interface features both in-built WiFi and a LAN port for a hard-wired connection. GivEnergy covers this inverter with a 12-year manufacturer warranty supported by a UK team.

product.name: testo 565i Smart vacuum pump 7 CFM 0564 5652 02.
product.description:
The new testo 565i vacuum pump performs refrigeration system and heat pump evacuations completely automatically. Once the desired vacuum target value is reached, pumping is automatically stopped and a vacuum hold test is initiated at the same time. Foreign gases and moisture can thus be removed safely, and data relating to the system's leak-tightness stored.

The data logging function ensures complete documentation. This allows evacuations to run completely independently - for maximum accuracy and efficiency.

Configuration, monitoring of live readings and sending of the measurement report are all easily controlled via the free testo Smart App. This allows you to remain flexible and saves valuable time.

To ensure perfect interaction between workflows, when the testo 565i is switched on, it automatically establishes a Bluetooth connection to the Testo measuring instruments and also the Smart App. The pump also guarantees maximum safety at all times thanks to its compatibility with A2L and A3 refrigerants.

Maximum convenience is guaranteed by the simple oil change mechanism and the sight glass for quick assessment of the oil level, along with the ergonomic handle.

To ensure high reliability, the built-in non-return valve provides effective protection against loss of vacuum, even in the event of unexpected power failures, and offers an extra layer of safety for uninterrupted operation.

product.name: SPI QuickBungs Radiator Bungs 2 Pack SEL9234
product.description:
The SPI innovative Radiator Bung - the perfect solution for preventing any mess or damage caused by dripping water during radiator maintenance or removal.

Designed to fit snugly into the valve aperture, our Radiator Bung provides a reliable seal to prevent any water leakage from your radiator. product.name: BWT Perla Silk 15L Water Softener
product.description:
This BWT Perla Water softener is designed to adapt to modern life and provide soft water when needed helping you save water, salt and energy.

Smart by design, performance driven, tuned for modern living and produces up to 50 litres of silky soft BWT Luxury Water a minute. Matching actual usage, lifestyle patterns and future demands allow the BWT Perla Silk to deliver an uninterrupted supply of softened water. Only regenerating when necessary it optimises the use of water and salt for maximum efficiency and real life running costs, making the BWT Perla Silk the perfect choice to meet the demands of modern living.

Smart options for a changing world. The BWT Perla Silk is smart, well designed and attractive to look at but its real beauty lies in it's a smart approach to delivering soft silky BWT Luxury Water. The smart and intuitive customer interface allows for straight forward communication in any language. Smart power options provide the flexibility of non-?mains electric operation, protection from power cuts and rechargeable options for off grid installations. All models in the range also benefit from the inclusion of a brine well safety check valve for extra peace of mind to you.

product.name: ProWarm Foil Underfloor Heating Mat (Wood, Vinyl & Carpet) - 2.0 M2
product.description:
Introducing the ProWarm Foil Underfloor Heating Mat - the perfect solution for those seeking a comfortable and efficient way to heat their wooden, vinyl, and carpet floors. This innovative product is designed to provide consistent and controllable warmth throughout any wooden flooring, from engineered boards to laminate and hardwood, as well as for vinyl or carpet floors.

The ProWarm Foil Underfloor Heating Mat is easy to install and is compatible with most types of floating floors, ensuring a quick and hassle-free installation process. It features a high-quality heating foil that provides reliable and even heat distribution throughout any floor.

Backed by an industry-leading lifetime warranty, the ProWarm Foil Underfloor Heating Mat provides peace of mind, ensuring you can enjoy the benefits of underfloor heating for years to come. Upgrade your home's heating system with the ProWarm Wood Underfloor Heating Mat and experience the ultimate in comfort and energy efficiency today.

Installation Requirements
These mats MUST be installed in conjunction with ProFoam or XPS Insulation.
When installing carpet/vinyl flooring, Heat-Pak Dual Overlay must also be used.
Ensure that the carpet and underlay combined tog value does not exceed 2.0. Note that in most cases, when carpet is laid, underfloor heating cannot be used as a primary heat source.
Kit Contents
ProWarm Foil Underfloor Heating Mat: Available in single, double, or triple mat configurations for areas over 12m2.
Digital Thermostat: Take control of your comfort with our range of programmable digital thermostats, each equipped with a floor temperature probe.
Adhesive Tape: Ensures a secure installation, keeping the mat or cable in place for a flawless finish.
Conduit: Adds an extra layer of durability and reliability to your heating system.
Specifications
The ProWarm Foil system is an ultra-thin electric radiant floor heating system primarily for use under laminate, engineered wood, glued hardwood, and other floating floors.
Made with Fluoropolymer insulated heating cables sandwiched between two layers of specially reinforced aluminum foil.
Uniform spacing of the heating elements ensures even heat distribution.
Available in heat outputs of 150 W/m2.
Hot and Cold lead junctions are uniquely designed for foolproof installation.
Meets all test requirements of IEC 60335 and SEMKO certified.
Cost-effective, flexible, and easy to install.
Provides close and uniform spacing of heating cables for higher comfort.
Wide range of heat loads and sizes ensure suitability to all kinds of floorings.

Cellars or Building prone to flood water

product.name: Bristan Onza Thermostatic Exposed Shower Valve with Riser Kit Chrome NZA SHXAR C
product.description:
This Bristan thermostatic exposed shower valve with riser kit in a stunning chrome finish offers a complete and highly functional upgrade for your bathroom. Designed by the trusted experts at Bristan, this complete package contains everything required for a swift setup, meaning there is no need to purchase extra components separately. Inside the box, you will find the main control unit, a durable hose, a practical hose retainer, a sturdy riser rail, and a clever single function handset. This means you can begin enjoying your new showering setup almost immediately after opening the packaging.

With its sleek chrome surface, this model brings a polished and bright look to your space, perfectly catching the light. The design is incredibly versatile, showcasing an understated grace characterized by flowing profiles and a cleverly recessed grip that sits beautifully within the unit. Because of these neutral and clean aesthetics, the unit beautifully complements both curved and angular bathroom styles, making it an excellent choice for a wide variety of decors.

Homeowners will appreciate the exceptional safety features integrated into this system, particularly the thermostatic cartridge. This technology ensures the water temperature remains stable even when other taps in the household are turned on, protecting your family from sudden bursts of freezing or scalding water. It also includes a built-in safety stop at a comfortable temperature to ensure safe showering for children and vulnerable users alike.

Maintenance is kept to an absolute minimum thanks to the practical handset nozzles. These specialized components are designed so that any limescale or daily grime can be wiped away simply by rubbing a finger or a cloth over them, keeping your water flowing perfectly without the need for harsh chemical cleaners.

Installation is incredibly straightforward, especially if you are replacing an older system. The unit features adjustable elbow inlets that can adapt to fit existing pipework centres up to 155mm. This smart adjustment capability means you can swap your old unit for this one without having to worry about costly and messy retiling work. It is an ideal, hassle-free upgrade for any busy household looking for reliability, safety, and timeless style.

product.name: Danfoss RAS-C2 15mm Angled TRV & Lockshield 013G6005
product.description: This Danfoss angled thermostatic radiator valve and lockshield set features a 15mm connection to fit standard central heating systems. Manufactured under an ISO 9002 quality system, this valve complies with European Standard EN 215 for performance. The compact sensor contains a high-performance liquid element designed for accurate room temperature control. An integrated frost protection setting guards against radiator freeze damage during cold weather. A positive shut-off feature ensures secure isolation of the radiator, preventing leaks during system maintenance. The valve features a flow-selectable, bi-directional design to match pipework layouts. The reversible flow mechanism cures noisy pipe hammer. Installers can secure the sensor quickly using a tool-free fitting system.

product.name: Danfoss RAS-C2 15mm Angled TRV & Lockshield (Liquid Sensor) with 10mm Push-Fit Elbow 013G6007
product.description:
This angled thermostatic radiator valve set from Danfoss features a liquid-filled sensor and a lockshield to deliver dependable temperature management in domestic and commercial properties. This plumbing package, which carries the manufacturer part number 013G6007, combines a 15mm angled TRV with a lockshield and a 10mm push-fit elbow. This design simplifies the job for professional installers working with compatible 10mm radiator pipework. By utilising the 10mm push-fit connection, engineers can achieve a quick and tool-free installation, which significantly speeds up the fit-out process on site.

The core of the system relies on a liquid-filled sensor actuator. This premium component delivers ultra-precise temperature regulation, responding reliably to minor fluctuations in room temperature. Installers will appreciate the revolver RA-FS flow-selectable valve body. This specialised design allows for flexible installation layouts, giving heating engineers the choice of either horizontal or vertical orientation depending on the pipework configuration in the room.

Additionally, this Danfoss unit incorporates several practical features designed to protect the heating system and facilitate easy maintenance. A built-in frost protection mechanism helps prevent freezing and potential pipe damage during severe cold spells, maintaining system integrity when the property is unoccupied. When it comes to decorating or system maintenance, the positive shut-off feature allows for straightforward valve removal. This means that radiators can be temporarily taken down without the need for complex and time-consuming draining procedures. With these trade-friendly attributes, the package provides a highly practical and reliable choice for modern central heating installations.

product.description: The RLV-D range of domestic lockshield valves are identical in finish and dimensions to the RA-FS valve bodies used with the RAS-D2 and RAS-C2 radiator thermostat combi packs. product.name: Danfoss Radiator Lockshield Angled Valve 15mm 003L020300
product.description: Danfoss RLV‑D angled lockshield valve (15mm) — a nickel‑plated brass lockshield engineered for reliable domestic heating balancing and isolation. Compact angled body with 15mm compression/system fittings and Rp 1/2 radiator connection, rated to 10 bar working pressure (16 bar test) and up to 120 °C. Ideal for tight radiator installations and compatible with Danfoss accessories and documentation (code 003L020300).

product.name: Danfoss RAS-C2 Angled TRV & Lockshield 10mm 013G6006
product.description:
This professional Danfoss radiator valve set offers a complete solution for regulating central heating systems with accuracy and efficiency. Designed specifically to streamline the installation process, this package includes both a thermostatic radiator valve and a matching lockshield component. The integration of a flow-selectable bi-directional valve body ensures that the unit can be mounted horizontally or vertically on either the flow or return pipework. This functional versatility eliminates common issues such as water hammer and reduces the time spent on site determining water flow direction.

Featuring a compact angled design, this ten-millimetre connection set is particularly suited for retrofitting or installing in restricted spaces where larger fittings would prove difficult to position. The physical orientation is angled, allowing for neat pipework connections directly from floors or walls.

The system utilises a highly responsive liquid sensor head which reacts swiftly to changes in ambient temperature. This sensor provides precise modulation of water flow through the radiator, maintaining a comfortable environment while optimizing energy consumption. Installers can offer clients reliable performance with an accurate thermal regulation range spanning from eight to twenty-eight degrees Celsius.

Aesthetically, the components feature a classic RAL 9016 surface finish that integrates neatly into modern domestic heating setups. This combi pack arrives complete with all necessary components in a single box, reducing the need to source separate fittings. By choosing this reliable Danfoss package, heating engineers can deliver a durable, standard-compliant setup that operates quietly and effectively.

product.name: Intergas Xtreme 24kW Combi Boiler NG 35004
product.description:
The Intergas Xtreme natural gas combi boiler delivers a 24kW heat output and operates on a 20% hydrogen blend. An integrated passive flue gas heat recovery (PFGHR) unit reclaims wasted heat to minimise fuel consumption and lowering CO2 emissions. Nitrogen oxide emissions are kept between 17.06mg/kWh and 20.33mg/kWh for reduced environmental impact. 

Domestic hot water is supplied at a flow rate between 11 and 14.5 litres per minute. Twin OpenTherm outlets are built into the unit to enable dual-zone thermostatic control. A factory-fitted RF module enables remote access and digital adjustments via compatible controls. 

Installation uses a single combined pipe connection for both the pressure relief valve and condensate discharge line. Fitting an Intergas system filter at the same time as installation extends the standard unit warranty coverage to 12 years upon registration.

product.name: Rothenberger RP30 Hydrostatic Pressure Testing Pump 30 Bars 61130
product.description:
The Rothenberger Pressure Test Pump - RP30 stands out as a dependable and adaptable tool, engineered to provide accurate testing outcomes. Its innovative dual-valve system, known as Twin-Valve, enables self-testing, ensuring the precision and functionality of the device. Additionally, the RP30 offers fine pressure adjustment, allowing for meticulous control throughout testing procedures.

Equipped with a testing hose featuring a steel mesh, the RP30 mitigates reading errors, especially when the hose expands during operation. This feature is pivotal in maintaining accurate and dependable pressure readings, bolstering the reliability of the testing process.

Crafted to endure diverse weather conditions, the RP30 boasts cold-resistant properties. Its steel container is coated with DURAMANT, enhancing durability and shielding against corrosion and wear. This robust construction ensures optimal functionality, even in demanding environments.

Key Features:

Dual-valve system (Twin-Valve) for self-testing and precise pressure adjustment
Testing hose with steel mesh to prevent reading mistakes during expansion
Weather and cold-resistant steel container with DURAMANT coating for durability
With the Rothenberger Pressure Test Pump - RP30, you can confidently obtain reliable and precise testing results across a broad spectrum of applications.

Specifications:

Testing and pressure range, with 20 psi steps (from): 0 psi
Testing and pressure range, with 20 psi steps (up to): 440 psi
Testing and pressure range, with 1 bar steps (from): 0 bar
Testing and pressure range, with 1 bar steps (up to): 30 bar
Connection: R 1/2 Inch
Delivery rate: 16 ml/Hub
Product length: 440 mm
Product height: 240 mm
Product weight: 4.5 kg
Product width: 200 mm
Installation:

Connect the pressure hose to the equipment to be tested with valve V1 opened and valve V2 closed.
Open one or several purge points in the installation. Remove the handle-locking hook and pump liquid until all air has been purged from the system. Close the vent points and then fill the installation operating the pump handle with ample movements.
Keep on pumping until the test pressure has been reached.
Close valve V1.
If the test pressure is exceeded during the pumping operation, slightly open valve V2 until the required pressure is attained. Then close all Valves.
If no leaks are present, no pressure drop should be detected in gauge readings. At test completion, open both valves V1 and V2.

This high-performance Stelrad low surface temperature double panel radiator is designed to meet the demanding requirements of commercial heating installations. Measuring 800mm x 1650mm, this K2 double panel model provides a reliable heating solution for a variety of professional applications.

The indirect cylinders are heated by a conventional boiler (either gas or oil) through a second high performance coil. The direct models are electrically heated cylinders, using the 3kW immersion heater supplied with the unit, and incorporating a high performance solar coil.

Both are capable of providing a system that meets the requirements of Building Regulations, provided they are correctly matched to the solar panels and the hot water requirement.

The solar range is based on the standard Stainless Lite cylinders, therefore still providing you with mains pressure hot water, low standing heat losses and lightweight construction.

product.name: Nuaire MRXBOXAB-ECO2B Wall mounted MVHR Unit
product.description: Nuaire's MRXBOXAB-ECO2B unit has been designed with automatic 100% bypass as listed on the SAP Product Characteristics Database (PCDB). The units operate by continuously extracting moisture-laden air from ‘wet’ rooms within the property and at the same time drawing in fresh supply air from outside. The heat from the extracted stale air is recovered via a heat exchanger inside the heat recovery unit which becomes tempered then filtered before supplying into the habitable rooms, creating comfortable and well-ventilated homes. The heat exchanger block within these units can recover up to 95% of the normally wasted heat. The two independent fans have full-speed control for background and boost ventilation rates. The unit has a summer bypass function. In warmer months this function automatically activates to ensure the property is being well-ventilated and comfort levels are maintained in the home by continuously drawing in fresh filtered air into the habitable rooms.

product.name: Nuaire Drimaster Loft Mounted Positive Input Ventilation System DRI-ECO-HEAT-HC
product.description: Drimaster-Eco Positive Input Ventilation (PIV) ventilation systems are the most effective method of curing and preventing condensation dampness. Recommended for planned and reactive ventilation servicing, essentially the concept is to introduce fresh, filtered air into the dwelling at a continuous rate, encouraging movement of air from inside to outside. To achieve this, the unit is mounted in the loft space, drawing air through the filters and inputting it, at ceiling level, into the property. An integrated heater tempers airflow should the temperature in the loft space drop below a set point, ensuring ultimate comfort in the home.

product.description:
The neoStat Pro embodies simplicity with its minimalist design and soft-glow digital display, providing essential temperature information for easy control. Providing subtle heating and cooling control, the neoStat Pro boosts comfort without sacrificing aesthetics or sustainability. It's an ideal solution for modern, energy-conscious homes.

Heating Mode
