product.name: Prowarm 16mm Pert-EVOH-PERT Pipe 300m 1827198021
product.description:
The Pert-Evoh-Pert Pipe is a high-quality and versatile piping solution designed for various heating and plumbing applications. It offers exceptional flexibility, durability, and performance, ensuring reliable and efficient operation in your systems.

Lightweight and Ultra Flexible

The Pert-Evoh-Pert Pipe is specifically engineered to be lightweight and ultra-flexible, making it incredibly easy to handle, bend, and install. Its flexibility allows for hassle-free routing around obstacles and tight corners, reducing installation time and effort.

Compliance with Standards

Rest assured that the Pert-Evoh-Pert Pipe meets the highest industry standards. It complies with the requirements of EN ISO 21003 and DIN 4726, ensuring its reliability and performance in heating and plumbing systems. You can trust its quality and compatibility with other components in your installations.

Oxygen Diffusion Barrier

The pipe features an oxygen diffusion barrier that completely encases the inner layer of PE-RT (Polyethylene of Raised Temperature Resistance). This barrier effectively prevents the entry of oxygen into the heating system through the pipe, safeguarding against corrosion and maintaining the integrity of the system over time.

Durable and Corrosion-Resistant

The Pert-Evoh-Pert Pipe is constructed entirely of plastics, providing a uniform and non-reactive structure. This design ensures its durability, corrosion resistance, and resistance to chemical reactions with metals commonly found in heating and plumbing systems. It offers long-lasting performance and reduces the risk of pipe degradation or failure.

Whether you're working on a residential or commercial project, the Pert-Evoh-Pert Pipe offers reliability, flexibility, and longevity. Its superior characteristics make it an ideal choice for various heating and plumbing applications where durability, performance, and ease of installation are paramount.

product.name: Prowarm 1"M  x 1" F - Ball Valve Pair (Red and Blue) 1300183055
product.description:
The ProWarm Manifold Ball Valve Pair is a dependable and adaptable option for managing the water flow in your heating system. Two 1 inch ball valves are included in this set, each nickel plated for increased durability and corrosion resistance.

The ball valves are 1 inch male to 1 inch female working perfectly with the ProWarm manifolds. The ball valves also feature EPDM rubber seals making for a more reliable connection, ensuring a water tight seal. The set comes in an easy-to-identify red and blue pair, making it possible to distinguish between the flow and return pipes.

These ball valves guarantee enduring performance and dependable operation thanks to their sturdy design and premium materials. The valves' lifespan is increased and their smooth performance is maintained throughout time thanks to the nickel plating's additional layer of protection.

The ball valves feature a quarter-turn handle, allowing for quick and effortless control of the water flow. When the handle is parallel to the pipe, the valve is fully open, enabling maximum flow. Conversely, when the handle is perpendicular to the pipe, the valve is fully closed, completely stopping the flow of water.

Installing the Manifold Ball Valve Pair is a straightforward process. Simply connect the valves to the corresponding flow and return pipes of your manifold using the appropriate fittings.

By incorporating ball valves into your heating system, you gain greater control and flexibility. These valves enable you to isolate specific circuits or components, making maintenance and repairs more convenient. They also allow for efficient system flushing and balancing, ensuring optimal performance and energy efficiency.

Whether you're installing a new heating system or upgrading an existing one, the Manifold Ball Valve Pair is a reliable choice. Experience the convenience, versatility, and peace of mind that comes with having full control over your heating system's water flow.

product.description:
This gas combi boiler package from Viessmann provides a highly reliable heating and hot water solution for your home, complete with a vertical flue. Designed to deliver exceptional energy savings, this system boasts an impressive standard seasonal efficiency of up to ninety-eight percent. At the heart of this appliance is the advanced MatriX-Plus burner, which works consistently to maintain clean combustion and high performance levels over time. This is paired with the durable Inox-Radial heat exchanger, which is made from high-quality stainless steel to resist corrosion and ensure your heating system operates at peak performance for years to come. 

To give homeowners complete confidence in their purchase, this model comes with a free extended five-year warranty when you register the product. Managing your heating is incredibly straightforward thanks to the user-friendly control panel. This interface features a clear LCD screen with a bright white backlight and four simple buttons, allowing you to adjust settings without any hassle. 

The unit is specifically engineered with space saving in mind, meaning it fits easily on the wall inside standard kitchen cupboards. This compact nature simplifies the process of finding the perfect spot for installation. Furthermore, the appliance operates with very quiet noise levels, which makes it an excellent choice for flat renovations or busy family homes where quietness is valued. Whether you are upgrading your current system or replacing an old unit, this efficient combination boiler package delivers outstanding dependability, comfort, and control.

product.name: Worcester Bosch HVO Conversion Kit 12/18 18kW (DM/HS II) 7731600278
product.description:
We offer HVO conversion kits suitable for our entire oil boiler range manufactured after September 2018. These new kits enable our oil boilers to be safely and efficiently converted to operate on HVO.

All of our oil boilers were tested on HVO to find the correct combination of burner components and settings to match the performance on kerosene. Our HVO kits contain labels for the appliance, burner and oil tank, with updated information regarding HVO. Typically, the kits contain a nozzle, flame sensor and replacement oil valve. Some of our conversion kits contain additional components such as an air damper disc or burner recirculation tube, depending on boiler model and output, in order for each variation of appliance to perform as efficiently as possible.​

The Vernis Blend electronic basin mixer with preset temperature and mains connection (230 V) is your professional solution for public and semi-public washrooms. Wherever safe hygiene, permanently reliable function, and low operating costs are required, the sensor tap of the hansgrohe Vernis Blend line is the first choice. Hygiene is improved, especially in those places where there are many different users, such as public wash rooms in restaurants, as well as in schools or hospitals and nursing homes.

product.description: Drayton supplies this pack of 10 TRV4 radiator valves with 15mm compression connections for straightforward pipe fitting. Tested to EN215 and ISO9001 quality standards, these units provide verified operational performance. A sensitive liquid-filled sensor gives prompt, accurate temperature adjustment. Non-stick internal components stop the valve mechanism from seizing over time. The reverse-flow capable design allows installation on either the flow or return pipework. A double gland seal protects the valve stem against water leaks. Supplied complete with matching lockshield valves under product code 07050180PCK1, this set suits both new installations and retrofit projects. Drayton covers the pack with an 18-month manufacturer warranty.

product.name: Drayton Angled TRV4 & Lock Shield 15mm Pack of 5
product.description:
This pack of five Drayton 15mm angled radiator valves operates with a liquid-filled sensor to maintain accurate room temperatures between 10°C and 30°C. The valves conform to EN215 standards and carry a Class I energy efficiency rating to ensure efficient heat control. 

Built with 15mm compression fittings, these units fit directly into domestic and light-commercial heating systems. Each valve features presettable internals and comes with an accompanying lockshield to make system balancing quicker. A non-stick, anti-limescale internal design prevents the valve from sticking, which reduces the need for ongoing maintenance.

Safe operation is aided by an integrated frost protection setting to prevent pipe damage during cold periods. Drayton provides an 18-month warranty for support after installation.

product.name: JG Speedfit x Speedfit Flexible Hose 22mmx22mm, 500mm (Braided) FLX27P
product.description:
This flexible plumbing connector from JG Speedfit offers an incredibly versatile and straightforward solution for connecting household pipework. Homeowners and DIY enthusiasts will appreciate how this product serves as a direct alternative to installing rigid copper or plastic pipework when plumbing in fixtures. When you are working in tight corners or awkward spaces under sinks and behind bath panels, bending rigid pipes can be extremely difficult. This product solves that problem by offering a flexible alternative that bends easily to make connections without putting stress on the surrounding pipework.

Safety is a key advantage during installation because the design completely removes any requirement for blowtorches, solder, flux, or messy glues. This flame-free setup means there is zero risk of heat damage to your home during the installation process. Instead of needing specialized plumbing equipment or applying heat, you can achieve a secure joint simply by pushing the pipe into the push-fit connector. The connection uses an internal collet system featuring stainless steel teeth combined with a high-quality main O-ring seal. This mechanism ensures a tight grip and a reliable seal that prevents leaks. If you ever need to alter the layout or remove the pipework, the demounting process is equally simple and requires no special equipment.

The build quality of this hose is outstanding, featuring a braided stainless steel outer layer. This braided metal sheath acts as a protective shield for the internal water feed, guarding it against accidental pinches, kinks, or physical damage. It is an excellent choice for domestic plumbing setups where durability is a priority. Measuring 500mm in length, it provides plenty of reach to bridge gaps between misaligned pipes. The entire product is designed, manufactured, and put together right here in the United Kingdom, ensuring high production standards. This reliable hose works perfectly with both copper and plastic pipes, making it a highly adaptable addition to your home improvement project.

Protective dust caps are supplied on the return rail, which can be removed when installing circuit actuator valves to open and close the flow of water to each pipe loop.

product.name: John Guest Underfloor 11 Port Manifold Stainless Steel JGUFHMAN11/3
product.description:
John Guest Speedfit 11 Port Underfloor Heating Manifold connects and centralises underfloor (UFH) pipework in one place and distributes warm water through the pipe circuits to provide even and comfortable heat. When combined with the JG Aura wiring centre and JG Aura heating controls, it also offers independent zone control.

Made from stainless steel, the manifold is manufactured to the highest standards. Fast and simple to install, it has a pre-fitted wall bracket and vibration isolation mount and uniquely features JG Speedfit connections and an integral air vent and fill valve. It also features pre-assembled flow rate indicators for adjusting flow and isolating pipe circuits. 

Protective dust caps are supplied on the return rail, which can be removed when installing circuit actuator valves to open and close the flow of water to each pipe loop.

product.name: JG Underfloor Lowfit Foiled Panel 16mm For 12mm Pipe Jglowfit16F
product.description:
John Guest Speedfit LowFit™ Foil Panels are designed to be installed over existing timber or concrete floors, while maintaining a low overall floor height. 

The 16mm panel is lightweight with high compressive strength and is  pre-grooved with return bends to eliminate the need for additional panel variations. Foil is moulded into the straight grooves to enhance system performance. 

Return bends can be easily cut with a small knife to suit the system design and speed up installation.

product.name: JG Underfloor Lowfit Castellated Panel 16mm For 12mm Pipe Jglowfit16
product.description:
John Guest Speedfit LowFit™ 16mm Castellated Panels are designed to provide a high output and low height screed floor underfloor system.

The 16mm panel has equally spaced castellations at 50mm to allow 12mm pipe to be clipped in securely and accurately as per design specifications.

Installation of the panels is fast and simple as it features an overlapping alignment system for simple hassle-free panel laying, as well as a super strong adhesive backing. This allows for the panel to be installed directly onto the existing sub floor structure. The open grid design ensures the screed layer poured on top flows smoothly and evenly over the panel.

product.name: JG Underfloor Lowfit Fibre Mesh Panel 16mm For 12mm Pipe Jglowfit16M
product.description:
John Guest Speedfit LowFit™ Mesh Panels are designed to be installed over existing timber or concrete floors, while maintaining a low overall floor height. The 16mm panel is lightweight with high compressive strength. 

The mesh layer allows for tiling directly to the panel* and is pre-grooved to include return bends that eliminate the need for additional panel variations.

*In some cases, a decoupling layer may be required, always consult the
flooring supplier for advice.

product.name: JG Underfloor Manifold Connection Kit MEXT452301
product.description:
John Guest Speedfit Underfloor Manifold Connection Kit is designed for connecting multiple John Guest Speedfit LowFit or John Guest Speedfit Underfloor Manifolds together. It is an ideal solution for larger properties that require multiple loops per room, or when additional underfloor heating (UFH) circuits are required on an existing installation.

The kit is easy to installl and comes complete with sealing washers. Simply remove the blanking plugs from the existing manifold at the end of both flow and return bars. Insert the sealing washer into the connectors and tighten. The additonal manifold can then be connected to the other end, creating further circuits, whilst still using a single JG Underfloor Thermomix Control Kit. 

The manifold flow meters will need to be recalibrated after installation on both manifolds to ensure optimum performance.

product.name: JG Underfloor Lowfit Castellated Panel 20mm For 15mm Pipe Jglowfit20
product.description:
John Guest Speedfit LowFit™ 20mm Castellated Panels are designed to provide a high output, low height, screeded underfloor system.

The 20mm panel has equally spaced castellations at 50mm to allow 15mm pipe to be clipped in securely and accurately as per design specifications

Installation of the panels is fast and simple as it features an overlapping alignment system for simple hassle-free panel laying, as well as a super strong adhesive backing. This allows for the panel to be installed directly onto the existing sub floor structure. The open grid design ensures the screed layer poured on top flows smoothly and evenly over the panel.

product.name: Robert Bosch GPT 18V-19 Press Tool 06019M2000
product.description:
If you’re looking for a cordless press tool that is powerful yet easy to manoeuvre in tight spaces, you’ll find the GPT 18V-19 Professional with its compact design and 360° rotatable head just right. You can join pipes in less than 3 seconds, depending on the pipe diameter, thanks to rapid pressing cycles. Plus, there is a status LED light with visual feedback on the pressing cycle, confirming a successful cycle and alerting you to potential errors.
The GPT 18V-19 Professional can be used for all common metal and plastic fittings. Compatible with Bosch compact press jaws, compact R-System press jaws, or Bosch approved press jaws, this tool handles pipes with various diameters. The maximum compression range for plastic pipes is 40 mm and 35 mm for metal. Compatible with the Bosch Professional 18V System and with the multi-brand battery alliance AMPShare.
The GPT 18V-19 Professional has a unique cover solution that provides your battery with the best protection.

product.name: Robert Bosch GPT 18V-32 Press Tool 06019M2100
product.description:
If you’re looking for a cordless press tool with the power to effortlessly handle a large variety of diameters, you’ll find the GPT 18V-32 Professional just right. Use the force of 32 kN to join pipes with plastic fittings up to 110 mm and metal fittings up to 54 mm. At the same time, this press tool is comfortable to work with: Thanks to rapid pressing cycles, it can press fittings in less than 5 seconds, depending on the pipe diameter. The 360° rotatable head enable easy maneuvering in tight spaces and an extra-bright worklight illuminates dark areas. Plus, there is a status LED light with visual feedback on the pressing cycle, confirming a successful cycle and alerting you to potential errors.
The GPT 18V-32 Professional can be used for all common metal and plastic fittings. Compatible with Bosch standard press jaws, standard R-System press jaws, or Bosch approved press jaws, this tool handles pipes with various diameters. The maximum compression range for plastic pipes is 110 mm and 54 mm for metal. Compatible with the Bosch Professional 18V System and with the multi-brand battery alliance AMPShare.
The GPT 18V-32 Professional has a unique cover solution that provides your battery with the best protection.

product.name: Heritage Hartlebury Recessed Shower Valve with Integral Two Outlet Diverter Chrome SHDC03
product.description:
This elegant Heritage Hartlebury concealed shower control with an integrated dual outlet diverter in a brilliant chrome finish brings classic style and modern functionality to your bathroom. Created by the trusted experts at Heritage, this classic fixture is designed to be recessed directly into your wall, presenting a neat and uncluttered look that maximises your showering area. By hiding the bulky working parts behind your tiles, you can enjoy a clean aesthetic that complements both traditional and transitional decor themes. The gleaming chrome surface catches the light beautifully, adding a touch of timeless sophistication to your sanctuary while being remarkably easy to wipe clean.

Homeowners with limited wall depth will appreciate the incredibly compact engineering of this model. It stands out as the most compact concealed option currently available, meaning it can slide effortlessly into exceptionally shallow wall cavities that would usually restrict your choice of brassware. This ultra-slim profile ensures that even homes with challenging architectural constraints or narrow partition walls can accommodate a high-performance built-in system without requiring extensive structural modification or false wall construction.

When it comes to performance, this unit is engineered specifically to suit the unique requirements of British plumbing systems. It is fully capable of operating efficiently across a wide spectrum of household water pressures, meaning you can enjoy reliable performance whether your home features a gravity-fed setup or a high-pressure mains system. The internal mechanics are tuned to deliver a generous and satisfying volume of water, transforming your daily routine into a fully immersive and soaking experience that rivals a luxury spa. With the built-in diverting component, you can effortlessly switch the water flow between dual outlets, such as a fixed overhead deluge and a practical handset, giving you total control over how you bathe.

At the heart of the unit are premium ceramic discs which replace traditional rubber washers. These discs are incredibly resistant to wear, preventing annoying drips and ensuring that the control handles turn with absolute smoothness every single time you use them. This advanced cartridge technology not only enhances your daily comfort by making temperature and flow adjustments effortless, but it also ensures that the fixture will remain a durable and reliable centerpiece in your home for many years to come.

product.name: Fernox Antifreeze Valve SV 62750
product.description:
The Fernox TF1 Antifreeze Valve is specifically designed to protect water-based air source Heat Pump heating systems. In cold weather when temperatures drop, systems that are not treated with a glycol-based fluid can freeze within the heat pump circuit potentially causing harmful and costly damage to vulnerable heat pump components and system pipework; eventually causing premature breakdown and repair.

The Fernox TF1 Antifreeze Valve is an essential, simple to install component developed to prevent frozen systems by detecting when the fluid in the circuit is close to freezing point i.e., when the circuit temperature reaches below 3° C. The TF1 Antifreeze Valve will automatically open and release system water, preventing ice from forming within the Heat Pump system and safeguarding the operation of the system.

product.name: Grant Vortex Eco Utility 15-21 21kW Oil Heat Only Boiler VTXECO15/21
product.description:
This 21kW oil heat only boiler from Grant is designed for efficient domestic heating. The unit carries a five-year guarantee when installed by a G1 installer, subject to terms and conditions. It achieves space heating efficiencies of between 91.7% and 92.7%. 

A factory-fitted condensate trap is located inside the boiler casing to streamline installation. This model integrates a modern Riello RDB burner alongside a patented heat exchanger constructed from stainless steel. Maintenance is simplified because the burner and combustion chamber are positioned at the front of the appliance. 

The appliance features an uncomplicated outer case, a streamlined control interface, and a simplified pipework layout. The wider range includes 15 to 21kW, 21 to 26kW, and 26 to 35kW models, with three sealed system alternatives also available in the same outputs. This condensing selection was developed to meet customer demand for competitively priced oil heating options.

product.name: Grant Vortex Eco Utility 21-26 26kW Oil Heat Only Boiler VTXECO21/26
product.description: Grant Vortex Utility oil-fired condensing boiler range delivers high-efficiency central heating for utility and kitchen installations. Featuring Grant stainless steel Vortex condensing heat exchanger with turbulator baffles and a Riello RDB burner, these free-standing boilers offer full front service access, multiple flueing options and straightforward installation. OFTEC approved and SEAI HARP A rated, the range is suited to replacing older oil boilers or new installations where compact footprint and reliable, efficient heating are required. The product is backed by a one year manufacturer warranty and a five year guarantee on the boiler heat exchanger (terms and conditions apply).

product.description:
Glow-worm supplies this Ultimate 3 35C combi boiler, delivering a 35kW output and high domestic hot water flow rates. Supplied under part code GWULT35CVFMISET, the package includes a vertical flue, a controls receiver, a MiSet RF thermostat, and a power system filter.

An automotive-grade aluminium heat exchanger conducts thermal energy within the unit. An ErP-rated modulating Grundfos pump limits power usage by matching its motor speed to current heating demand. System settings are managed using a digital control panel with a bright LCD display.

This model connects directly with current Glow-worm flue components for flexible positioning during installation. A 5-year guarantee comes as standard, which increases to a 10-year term when installed alongside the included filter and registered via Club Energy.

product.name: Glow-Worm Ultimate 3 35C Combi Boiler with Horizontal Flue, Glow-worm Controls Receiver Miset RF Thermostat & Glow-worm Power System Filter GWULT35CHFMISET
product.description:
Glow-Worm supplies the Ultimate 3 35C combi boiler, delivering a 35kW output and high domestic hot water flow rates using an automotive grade aluminium heat exchanger. An integrated ErP modulating Grundfos pump automatically adjusts performance to lower electricity usage. System settings are managed via a bright LCD display on the front control panel. 

Supplied under product code GWULT35CHFMISET, this full kit contains a horizontal flue compatible with existing Glow-worm flue ranges. The package includes a MiSet RF wireless thermostat alongside a Glow-worm Power System Filter. Installing the provided filter and registering the boiler through Club Energy extends the standard 5-year warranty to a 10-year period.

product.name: Glow-Worm Ultimate 3 30C Combi Boiler with Vertical Flue, Glow-worm Controls Receiver Miset RF Thermostat & Glow-worm Power System Filter GWULT30CVFMISET
product.description:
This Glow-Worm gas boiler package provides an all-in-one heating and hot water solution designed to maximise home comfort and energy savings. The bundle comes complete with the Ultimate combi boiler, a vertical flue, a MiSet RF wireless thermostat, and a power system filter. 

At the heart of the boiler is a high-quality, automotive-grade aluminium heat exchanger. This premium material ensures excellent heat transfer, superb reliability, and long-lasting performance, meaning your home stays warm and comfortable when you need it most. product.description: The Plumbright electrolytic scale reducer provides high performance protection against limescale deposits. This electrolytic scale reducer can extend the lifespan of the heating system and improve operating efficiency. Part L of the Building Regulations states that where mains water hardness exceeds 200 ppm the water in the hot water circuit must be treated to reduce the rate of limescale deposition and in doing so maintain energy efficiency. As specified in the Domestic Services Compliance Guide an Electrolytic Scale Reducer is the most efficient treatment method.

product.name: Calmag Callytic 15mm Mini Compression Electrolytic Scale Inhibitor
product.description: The Calmag CalLytic Mini is designed to work in hard water areas, by protecting the central heating form limescale build up, keeping it working efficiently. The harder the water, the more minerals it contains, and as such the more likely it is to have limescale problems. A more efficient system allows for a warmer, longer life boiler system, allowing for lower fuel bills and less maintenance costs. As well as your heating system, the CalLytic will help protect household, kitchen and bathroom appliances from limescale build up, such as kettles and showers. The CalLytic Mini unit is available for use with 15mm, and 22mm pipework, and comes with 15mm-22mm pushfit fittings.

product.name: Plumbright 15mm Compression Magnetic Scale Reducer PBM/15/CPS
product.description: Plumbright Magnetic Scale Reducers (MSR) can be used in both domestic and commercial properties. Magnetic Scale Reducers are recommended as single appliance protection installation. The MSR can be fitted vertically or horizontally and there is no preferred direction of flow. It includes simple compression fittings for easy connection to standard pipe. The MSR consists of a copper body with a permanent magnet inside. Magnetic Scale Reducers are installed to help prevent the build-up of limescale formation (mainly made from calcium carbonate) in appliances. By preventing limescale formation, the damaging potential reduction in operational life of the appliances and the costly drop in efficiency can both be reduced or minimised. An MSR creates a magnetic field which changes the crystal structure of calcium carbonate making it less likely to cluster as limescale on heat exchangers, elements and pipework.

product.name: Heatmiser neoStat V3 12V Smart Thermostat - White neoStat V312VWHITE
product.description:
The Heatmiser neoStat 12V is a 12V powered smart thermostat that offers advanced features and app control. It is the perfect upgrade option for those who want to take advantage of app control and have existing low voltage cabling installed. The neoStat 12V is compatible with our 12V Wiring Centre UH8-N and previous generation UH1 systems.

Key Features:

App Control: Take full control of your heating system with the Heatmiser app, allowing you to adjust temperature settings, program schedules, and monitor your heating from anywhere using your smartphone or tablet.
Easy Upgrade: The neoStat 12V is designed as an easy upgrade route, making use of existing low voltage cabling, saving time and effort during installation.
Mesh Networking: The neoStat communicates wirelessly with the neoHub, forming a reliable and scalable network system. Each mains powered neoStat acts as a repeater, ensuring a strong and stable signal throughout your home.
Flexible Operation: The neoStat can be configured to function as a thermostat or as a timer. This means you can take control of not only your heating but also other devices such as towel rails or lighting, offering you greater convenience and flexibility.
Easy Navigation: The neoStat series features an intuitive and user-friendly programming system, with all options conveniently displayed at the bottom of the backlit display.
Self Learning Preheat: The self-learning preheat feature calculates the optimal heat-up time to ensure your home is warm and comfortable when you wake up or return home. It continuously adjusts and optimizes this preheat time throughout the year, helping you save energy and money.
Programmable Modes: Choose between thermostat mode or timer mode to suit your heating preferences and requirements.
Holiday Function: The neoStat includes a holiday function that allows you to set a specific temperature or turn off the heating completely when you're away, helping you save energy and maintain control even when you're not at home.
Temperature Hold: The temperature hold feature allows you to set a desired temperature for a specific duration. After the set time expires, the thermostat will return to its normal programmed settings.
Air Sensor Connection: Connect an air sensor to the neoStat to measure and control the temperature in a specific location, providing accurate and localized temperature readings.
Floor Sensing Mode: The neoStat supports floor sensing mode (probe not included), enabling precise temperature control in electric floor heating systems.
Upgrade to the Heatmiser neoStat 12V Smart Thermostat and experience the convenience of app control, advanced features, and flexible programming options. Take control of your heating system and enjoy a comfortable home environment with ease.

product.description:
This high-quality Solax home energy package combines an intelligent single-phase hybrid inverter with a high-capacity lithium iron phosphate storage unit to help you control your domestic power usage. The Solax X1 G4 3.0kW hybrid inverter acts as the central control unit for your domestic solar setup, intelligently directing electricity between your solar panels, your home, the national grid, and your storage unit. By managing this distribution, the device ensures that you make the most of the green energy generated on your roof, significantly increasing your household self-consumption. During unexpected blackouts, the unit provides emergency power, keeping your essential appliances running when the local electrical network fails. Its efficient design ensures minimal energy loss during conversion, helping you secure the greatest possible return on your solar technology investment.

Paired with the inverter is the Triple Power 5.8 kWh battery, which utilises advanced lithium iron phosphate technology to safely store any excess electricity generated during the day. Rather than letting your surplus solar power go back to the grid, you can save it for when you need it most, such as during expensive peak evening hours or throughout the night. This high-performance storage unit is celebrated for its outstanding safety credentials, dependable operation, and exceptionally long service life. With 5.8 kWh of usable storage at your disposal, you can dramatically cut your monthly utility expenses and enjoy greater energy independence.

As your household power needs grow, this flexible Solax system can be easily expanded. On a standard single-phase setup, you can scale your storage capacity up to a limit of 17.4 kWh by connecting up to three storage units in total, which consists of one master battery and two secondary units. For those looking to increase their capacity, compatible slave batteries can be purchased using product code 628025. This exclusive bundled package offers a comprehensive solution for modern homeowners who want to future-proof their properties, lower their carbon footprint, and protect themselves against rising utility tariffs.

This comprehensive home energy package from Alpha ESS combines a powerful five kilowatt hybrid inverter with a high-capacity ten point one kilowatt-hour battery storage system to help homeowners take control of their domestic electricity supply. It supports both alternating current and direct current coupling, which maximises efficiency and ensures simple integration with your current electrical setup. The customisable storage design means your home energy capacity can scale up over time. Adding extra physical modules is straightforward, protecting your initial financial investment for years to come. You can easily increase your storage capacity in future by adding further ten kilowatt-hour modules as your household requirements grow. For homes requiring substantial reserves, the system can scale up to an impressive sixty point six kilowatt-hours, giving you the flexibility to aim for complete self-reliance or standard daily utility bill savings.

During unexpected power cuts, the system acts as an uninterruptible power source to supply emergency electricity to your entire household, keeping essential appliances running. product.name: Plumbright TRV 15mmx1/2" Column Head Style, Angled Radiator Valve & Lockshield Chrome 690000PR
product.description: This angled thermostatic valve set from Plumbright features a matching lockshield and a sleek chrome finish, designed to provide efficient temperature management for household heating systems. Inside the valve, a liquid-filled sensor continuously monitors the surrounding air, reacting swiftly to changes in room temperature to maintain a comfortable living space. Manufactured from high-quality brass coated in shiny chrome, this durable set is engineered to resist corrosion, ensuring your home heating remains dependable for many years to come. The user-friendly wheel-head controller has a highly visible dial, allowing you to choose between five distinct levels of warmth with complete precision. Because the flow can run in either direction, this unit offers maximum flexibility during setup, fitting easily onto your pipework without fuss. An integrated safety feature guards your plumbing against freezing, automatically opening the valve if temperatures drop dangerously low during winter. It connects securely via a fifteen-millimetre threaded inlet to a half-inch compression outlet, standing up to water pressures of ten bar and regulating temperatures up to twenty-eight degrees Celsius. This stylish addition to your home not only looks great with its bright metallic exterior, but it also plays a key role in reducing energy waste by ensuring you only heat rooms when necessary. Homeowners will appreciate the classic styling of the column head design, which blends effortlessly with both traditional and contemporary radiator styles. Adjusting the warmth in your bedroom, living room, or hallway becomes an effortless task, giving you total control over your home environment throughout the changing seasons. The inclusion of a matching lockshield means you can balance your heating system once and enjoy consistent, even warmth across all your radiators without needing further adjustments.

product.description: Reliance Valves Ausimix Compact TMV2 Thermostatic Mixing Valve blends hot and cold water to a constant and safe outlet temperature to prevent scalding. It is also compliant with Building Regulation Part G. here are two options available: the 2-in-1 valve comes complete with strainers and check valves, whereas the 4-in-1 also includes test ports and isolation valves. Both versions feature a unique temperature adjustment tool incorporated into the cap. Ausimix Compact is available with flat faced union connections or with SharkBite push-fit connections. product.name: Manrose MF100T 100mm Inline Mixed Flow Fan with Timer
product.description: The Manrose 100mm Inline Mixed Flow Fan with Timer - MF100T is a powerful inline extractor fan. The inline fan can be installed in the loft or ceiling void above the bathroom, toilet or kitchen. Ducting is attached to each end of the fan with one length going to an internal grille in the ceiling of the bathroom and the other going to a grille on the external wall, soffit or roof.  Inline fans are particularly great for bathrooms because you can site the extraction grille directly above the shower or bath, thus extracting the steam at source. With no electrics in the bathroom they are easy to install, saving both electrician and decorating costs and since they are housed in the loft or ceiling void the noise levels are also extremely low.

UltraTile Proflex Tile Adhesive - Flexible Single Part is a single-part, rapid-setting, flexible adhesive designed for wall and floor tiles. Formulated with enhanced adhesion and flexibility, it's perfect for areas prone to slight movement or vibration, such as underfloor heating systems, wet rooms, or exterior installations.

Key Features:

Suitable Tiles: Ceramic, porcelain, glass, mosaics, marble, travertine, granite, limestone, terracotta, quarry, slate, quartz, brick slips.
Adheres to Surfaces: Concrete, sand/cement screed, plywood overlay (15mm min), tile backer boards, cement-faced fiber boards, anhydrite/calcium sulfate/gypsum-based screeds, firm and stable plaster, plasterboard, sand/cement render, concrete brick/block, hard vinyl tiles, flooring grade asphalt.
Light Foot Traffic: Can withstand light foot traffic within 3 hours of installation, depending on temperature and substrate.
Specifications:

Unit Size: 20kg bags
Standard Conformity: EN 12004 Class C2FT S1
Bed Thickness: 3mm-20mm
Coverage: For a 3mm bed thickness, you will require 4.5kg of material per m2
Pot Life: 60 minutes depending on temperature and substrate
Set Time: 2.5 hours dependent on temperature and substrate
Storage: Store in unopened bags, clear of the ground in dry conditions. Avoid frost. Ideal storage temperatures are between 5˚C and 25˚C.
Shelf Life: 12 months in the above conditions. Note: The use of this product after the end of the declared storage period may increase the risk of an allergic reaction. High temperatures and high humidity will lead to a reduced shelf life.
Ensure all tiling follows the correct British/European standard and incorporates movement joints as specified therein. Color variation may occur in all raw materials, but this does not affect the consistency or characteristics of the product.

The unit is built on an advanced boiler design that minimises installation complexity while delivering excellent performance for your customers. Key to its installation speed is the redesigned layout for standard pipework, which simplifies the process of replacing older units and reduces time spent on site.

For long term durability, this appliance features a radial stainless steel heat exchanger as its primary component. This material provides exceptional resistance to corrosion and thermal stress, ensuring reliable operation over many years. This model is future proof, carrying certification for compatibility with a twenty percent hydrogen gas blend, meaning it is prepared for upcoming changes in the national grid. product.name: Mira Advance Heatloop Electric Shower 8.7 KW 1.1785.006
product.description:
This efficient electric shower from Mira delivers a sustainable and highly accessible bathing experience for the modern household. Engineered to support eco-conscious homes, this appliance is compatible with domestic waste-water warmth recycling systems, allowing you to reclaim heat from draining water to preheat incoming supplies. By integrating this technology, users can enjoy a massive reduction in their hot water power consumption. Specifically, you can cut down on showering energy usage by up to forty percent when compared to standard electrical alternatives. This exceptional efficiency also helps to improve the overall Energy Performance Certificate rating of your property, making it an attractive addition for landlords and energy-conscious homeowners alike.

In addition to outstanding efficiency, the unit is built to withstand the challenges of seasonal weather changes. When the cold winter months arrive and mains water temperatures drop, the system automatically compensates for flow fluctuations. This ensures that you receive a reliable and stable stream of warm water without sudden drops in pressure or temperature, ensuring a comfortable experience all year round.

Safety and usability are at the heart of this design, which has been honoured with the RNIB Tried and Tested award. It features highly accessible controls with high contrast on critical touchpoints, ensuring that users with visual impairments or limited dexterity can operate the settings with confidence and ease. To prevent any risk of scalding, installers can select from four different preset maximum temperature configurations, establishing a safe thermal limit that protects children and vulnerable family members.

To guarantee a long operational life, this Mira model utilises specialised Clearscale Pro technology. This system drastically reduces the build up of limescale inside the internal components, allowing the unit to significantly outlast rival products on the market, even in areas with particularly hard water. Choosing this reliable heating appliance ensures long-term performance, safety, and remarkable utility savings.

product.name: DAB 3 Esybox Max 45/120 M 220-240 V Twin Pump Set 70240090
product.description: Esybox Max is an integrated pumping system for water pressurization in commercial building service. It is composed of modular elements that allow different configurations: single, double, triple or quadruple system are possible, to cover the needs of medium/large condominiums and high buildings (even over 14 floors). Each unit consists of the hydraulic connection base and the pumping unit which includes an electronic vertical multi-impeller pump, display, Wi-Fi module, pressure sensors, non-return valve on delivery and an expansion tank. The innovative support base of the pumping unit and the wireless communication between the pumps make it possible to assemble the unit directly at the installation site (O.S.A. concept) even by one person. The variable frequency drive keeps the pressure constant according to the request and also thanks to the water-cooled permanent magnet motor, it allows greater efficiency, silence and energy savings. Compatible with the DConnect service. EsyBox Max is ACS certified.

product.description: Esytank Pro is designed to provide a compact water storage option for the award winning Esyline booster set range. Similar to the Esyline pump range, Esytank Pro tank systems focus on modularity, making site access easy and minimising footprint. product.name: Floorwarmers Electric Underfloor Heating Mat Kit 100W - 4.5m2
product.description:
The Floorwarmers Electric Underfloor Heating Mat Kit 100W offers a versatile solution for various floor coverings, ensuring exceptional reliability and hassle-free installation. Here's what you need to know about this kit:

Key Features:

Versatile Solution: Designed to cater to all types of floor coverings, offering exceptional reliability and hassle-free installation.
Long-lasting Warranty: Each product comes with a generous 25-year warranty, providing peace of mind and ensuring satisfaction.
Thermostat Options: A wide range of thermostats is available to enhance your heating experience, including advanced WiFi thermostats for smart home automation and stylish touchscreen thermostats.
Affordable Quality: Combines affordability with quality, offering excellent value for money and luxury of heated floors at an affordable price point.
Multiple Output Options: Available in 150W and 200W outputs, suitable for both primary heating and supplemental heating purposes.
Kit Includes:

Underfloor Heating Sticky Mat (Two individual mats if kit size is over 12m²)
Floor Primer: High-performance universal priming/sealing agent suitable for various substrates
Roller: High-quality roller for applying floor primer to the subfloor
Adhesive Tape: Assists in holding the mat or cable in position during installation
Digital Thermostat (if selected): Allows adjustment of heat settings for added convenience
Conduit
Specifications:

Cable Type: Twin wire cable 100w/m²
Cable Thickness: 3mm
Mat Width: 500mm
Warranty: 25-year manufacturer warranty
Tested: 100% earth screened
Cold Tail Length: 2m
Certifications: UKCA and CE Approved
Installation Guide:

Divide the floor into rectangles and calculate the area to be heated, covering approximately 90% with the heating mat.
Lay insulation boards over concrete floors to minimize heat loss and ensure quicker warm-up times.
Start laying the mat close to the thermostat, ensuring the loops are equally spaced and attaching the mat to the subfloor using the provided tape.
Install an RCD fused spur to power the thermostatic controller/programmer and the mat system, and lay the temperature probe equidistant between two cable loops.
Lay a thin, self-leveling screed over the mat or trowel flexible tile adhesive directly over the mat before laying floor tiles. Allow the adhesive to cure before switching on the system.
Note: Alternative brands of heating mats may be supplied during stock shortages.

Experience the ultimate warmth and comfort throughout your living space with the Floorwarmers Electric Underfloor Heating Mat Kit 100W.

product.name: Floorwarmers Electric Underfloor Heating Mat Kit 200W - 4.0m2
product.description:
The Floorwarmers Electric Underfloor Heating Mat Kit 200W offers a versatile solution for all types of floor coverings, known for its exceptional reliability and hassle-free installation. Here's what you need to know about this kit:

Key Features:

Versatile Solution: Designed to cater to all types of floor coverings, ensuring exceptional reliability and hassle-free installation.
Long-lasting Warranty: Each product comes with a generous 25-year warranty, providing peace of mind and ensuring satisfaction.
Thermostat Options: A wide range of thermostats is available to enhance your heating experience, including advanced WiFi thermostats for smart home automation and stylish touchscreen thermostats.
Affordable Quality: Combines affordability with quality, offering excellent value for money and luxury of heated floors at an affordable price point.
Multiple Output Options: Available in 150W and 200W outputs, suitable for both primary heating and supplemental heating purposes.
Kit Includes:

Underfloor Heating Sticky Mat (Two individual mats if kit size is over 12m²)
Floor Primer: High-performance universal priming/sealing agent suitable for various substrates
Roller: High-quality roller for applying floor primer to the subfloor
Adhesive Tape: Assists in holding the mat or cable in position during installation
Digital Thermostat (if selected): Allows adjustment of heat settings for added convenience
Conduit
Specifications:

Cable Type: Twin wire cable 100w/m²
Cable Thickness: 3mm
Mat Width: 500mm
Warranty: 25-year manufacturer warranty
Tested: 100% earth screened
Cold Tail Length: 2m
Certifications: UKCA and CE Approved
Installation Guide:

Divide the floor into rectangles and calculate the area to be heated, covering approximately 90% with the heating mat.
Lay insulation boards over concrete floors to minimize heat loss and ensure quicker warm-up times.
Start laying the mat close to the thermostat, ensuring the loops are equally spaced and attaching the mat to the subfloor using the provided tape.
Install an RCD fused spur to power the thermostatic controller/programmer and the mat system, and lay the temperature probe equidistant between two cable loops.
Lay a thin, self-leveling screed over the mat or trowel flexible tile adhesive directly over the mat before laying floor tiles. Allow the adhesive to cure before switching on the system.
Note: Alternative brands of heating mats may be supplied during stock shortages.

product.name: Navien 37kW Combi Boiler NCB500
product.description:
Navien equips the NCB500 combi boiler with stainless steel heat exchangers to provide long-term heating efficiency and durable construction. Engineered with a compact 280mm depth, the appliance fits inside standard kitchen cupboards while reaching hot water outputs up to 41kW. 

An internal auto mixing valve works alongside a flow adjustment valve to maintain steady domestic hot water temperatures at a flow rate of up to 15.2 litres per minute at a 35 degree Celsius temperature rise. This boiler operates with a 6:1 turndown ratio to deliver a broad modulation range. 

Achieving an ErP efficiency rating of 93%, it reaches an ErP A+ efficiency standard when connected to three Smart Plus room thermostats for multizone heating. Manufactured to the same build specifications as the NCB700 model, it features an integrated text-driven digital screen with a two-channel timer for energy monitoring.

product.name: Navien 28kW Combi Boiler NCB300
product.description: This gas condensing combination boiler from Navien delivers a 28kW domestic hot water output, making it highly suited for smaller properties. Built with stainless steel heat exchangers, this unit resists corrosion to maintain high thermal efficiency over time. Navien includes a five-year warranty out of the box to cover parts and performance. A 6:1 turndown ratio provides a wide modulation range to reduce energy consumption by matching household heating demand. The lightweight design and compact dimensions ensure the unit fits easily inside a kitchen cupboard. As the entry model in this range, the boiler features a built-in LCD control panel to simplify user adjustments.

product.name: Navien 41kW Combi Boiler NCB500
product.description:
Navien designed this combi boiler to achieve a hot water output of up to 41kW. Equipped with stainless steel heat exchangers, the appliance maintains long-term operating efficiency. A compact 280mm depth enables installation inside standard storage cupboards. 

The unit delivers a hot water flow rate of up to 16.8 litres per minute at a 35°C temperature rise. A 6:1 turndown ratio provides a broad modulation range for controlled fuel consumption. 

It holds an ErP efficiency rating of 93%, reaching an ErP A+ energy efficiency rating when installed with three Smart Plus room thermostats for multizone heating. Built to the same construction specification as the NCB700 series, this model includes an auto mixing valve alongside a flow adjustment valve to prevent changes in hot water temperature or flow rate. System parameters are managed through a text-driven digital display panel featuring an integrated two-channel timer for energy tracking.
